title: Vishnu Sahasranama
author: Vyasa
description: The 1000 names of Lord Vishnu from the Anushasana Parva of the Mahabharata, recited by Bhishma to Yudhishthira as the supreme means of liberation. Composed in 107 shlokas in Anushtup meter.

dhyanaShlokas.sanskritDevanagari:
क्षीरोदन्वत्प्रदेशे शुचिमणिविलसत्सैकते मौक्तिकानां
मालाक्लृप्तासनस्थः स्फटिकमणिनिभैर्मौक्तिकैर्मण्डिताङ्गः ।
शुभ्रैरभ्रैरदभ्रैरुपरिविरचितैर्मुक्तपीयूषवर्षैः
रानन्दी नः पुनीयादरिनलिनगदाशङ्खपाणिर्मुकुन्दः ॥ १॥
dhyanaShlokas.transliteration:
kṣīrodanvatpradeśe śucimaṇivilasatsaikate mauktikānāṃ
mālākḷptāsanasthaḥ sphaṭikamaṇinibhairmauktikairmaṇḍitāṅgaḥ |
śubhrairabhrairadabhrairupariviracitairmuktapīyūṣavarṣaiḥ
ānandī naḥ punīyādarinalinagadāśaṅkhapāṇirmukuṇdaḥ || 1 ||
dhyanaShlokas.translation: In the region of the Milk Ocean, on a pure shore glistening with gems, seated on a throne made of pearl garlands, His body adorned with pearls resembling crystal gems, with abundant white clouds above showering streams of nectar — may that blissful Mukunda, holding lotus, mace, and conch, purify us.

dhyanaShlokas.sanskritDevanagari:
भूः पादौ यस्य नाभिर्वियदसुरनिलश्चन्द्रसूर्यौ च नेत्रे
कर्णावाशाः शिरो द्यौर्मुखमपि दहनो यस्य वास्तेयमब्धिः ।
अन्तःस्थं यस्य विश्वं सुरनरखगगोभोगिगन्धर्वदैत्यैः
चित्रं रंरम्यते तं त्रिभुवनवपुषं विष्णुमीशं नमामि ॥ २॥
dhyanaShlokas.transliteration:
bhūḥ pādau yasya nābhirviyadasuranilascandrasūryau ca netre
karṇāvāśāḥ śiro dyaurmukhamapi dahano yasya vāsteyamabdhiḥ |
antaḥsthaṃ yasya viśvaṃ suranarakhaagagobhogigandarvadaityaiḥ
citraṃ raṃramyate taṃ tribhuvanavapuṣaṃ viṣṇumīśaṃ namāmi || 2 ||
dhyanaShlokas.translation: He whose feet are the earth, whose navel is space, whose breath is wind, whose eyes are the sun and moon, whose ears are the directions, whose head is heaven, whose mouth is fire, and whose ocean is the abdomen — within whom the entire universe of gods, men, birds, cattle, serpents, gandharvas, and demons delights in wondrous play — to that Vishnu, the Lord whose body is the three worlds, I bow.
Om, salutation to the Blessed Lord Vasudeva.

dhyanaShlokas.sanskritDevanagari:
ॐ शान्ताकारं भुजगशयनं पद्मनाभं सुरेशं
विश्वाधारं गगनसदृशं मेघवर्णं शुभाङ्गम् ।
लक्ष्मीकान्तं कमलनयनं योगिभिर्ध्यानगम्यं (योगिहृद्ध्यानगम्यं)
वन्दे विष्णुं भवभयहरं सर्वलोकैकनाथम् ॥ ३॥
dhyanaShlokas.transliteration:
oṃ śāntākāraṃ bhujagaśayanaṃ padmanābhaṃ sureśaṃ
viśvādhāraṃ gaganasadṛśaṃ meghavarṇaṃ śubhāṅgam |
lakṣmīkāntaṃ kamalanayanam yogibhirdhyānagamyaṃ
vande viṣṇuṃ bhavabhayaharaṃ sarvalokaikanātham || 3 ||
dhyanaShlokas.translation: Of serene form, reclining on the serpent Shesha, with a lotus in His navel, Lord of the gods, the support of the universe, vast as the sky, dark as a cloud, with auspicious limbs, beloved of Lakshmi, lotus-eyed, attainable through meditation by yogis — I salute that Vishnu, the remover of the fear of worldly existence, the sole Lord of all worlds.

dhyanaShlokas.sanskritDevanagari:
मेघश्यामं पीतकौशेयवासं
श्रीवत्साङ्कं कौस्तुभोद्भासिताङ्गम् ।
पुण्योपेतं पुण्डरीकायताक्षं
विष्णुं वन्दे सर्वलोकैकनाथम् ॥ ४॥
dhyanaShlokas.transliteration:
meghaśyāmaṃ pītakauśeyavāsaṃ
śrīvatsāṅkaṃ kaustubhodbhāsitāṅgam |
puṇyopetaṃ puṇḍarīkāyatākṣaṃ
viṣṇuṃ vande sarvalokaikanātham || 4 ||
dhyanaShlokas.translation: Dark as a rain cloud, clothed in yellow silk, bearing the Shrivatsa mark, His body radiant with the Kaustubha gem, endowed with all virtue, with eyes wide as a lotus — I salute Vishnu, the sole Lord of all worlds.

dhyanaShlokas.sanskritDevanagari:
नमः समस्तभूतानामादिभूताय भूभृते ।
अनेकरूपरूपाय विष्णवे प्रभविष्णवे ॥ ५॥
dhyanaShlokas.transliteration:
namaḥ samastabhūtānāmādibhūtāya bhūbhṛte |
anekarūparūpāya viṣṇave prabhaviṣṇave || 5 ||
dhyanaShlokas.translation: Salutation to Him who is the first being of all beings, the upholder of the earth, who assumes countless forms — to Vishnu, the all-powerful.

dhyanaShlokas.sanskritDevanagari:
सशङ्खचक्रं सकिरीटकुण्डलं
सपीतवस्त्रं सरसीरुहेक्षणम् ।
सहारवक्षःस्थलकौस्तुभश्रियं (स्थलशोभिकौस्तुभं)
नमामि विष्णुं शिरसा चतुर्भुजम् ॥ ६॥

छायायां पारिजातस्य हेमसिंहासनोपरि
आसीनमम्बुदश्यामामायताक्षमलंकृतम् ।
चन्द्राननं चतुर्बाहुं श्रीवत्साङ्कितवक्षसं
रुक्मिणीसत्यभामाभ्यां सहितं कृष्णमाश्रये ॥ ७॥
dhyanaShlokas.transliteration:
sasaṅkhacakraṃ sakirīṭakuṇḍalaṃ
sapītavastraṃ sarasīruhekṣaṇam |
sahāravakṣaḥsthalakaustubhaśriyaṃ
namāmi viṣṇuṃ śirasā caturbhujam || 6 ||

chāyāyāṃ pārijātasya hemasiṃhāsanopari
āsīnamambudaśyāmāmāyatākṣamalaṃkṛtam |
candrānanaṃ caturbāhuṃ śrīvatsāṅkitavakṣasaṃ
rukmiṇīsatyabhāmābhyāṃ sahitaṃ kṛṣṇamāśraye || 7 ||
dhyanaShlokas.translation: With conch and discus, with crown and earrings, clothed in yellow, with lotus-like eyes, with the beauty of the Kaustubha gem on His chest adorned with garlands — I bow my head to the four-armed Vishnu. In the shade of the Parijata tree, seated on a golden throne, dark as a cloud, wide-eyed and beautifully adorned, moon-faced, four-armed, with the Shrivatsa mark on His chest — I take refuge in Krishna, accompanied by Rukmini and Satyabhama.

verses.sanskritDevanagari:
विश्वं विष्णुर्वषट्कारो भूतभव्यभवत्प्रभुः ।
भूतकृद्भूतभृद्भावो भूतात्मा भूतभावनः ॥ १॥
verses.transliteration:
viśvaṃ viṣṇurvaṣaṭkāro bhūtabhavyabhavatprabhuḥ |
bhūtakṛdbhūtabhṛdbhāvo bhūtātmā bhūtabhāvanaḥ || 1 ||

names.name: विश्वम्
names.meaning: The entire universe; He who is the totality of all existence, being everything that is

names.name: विष्णुः
names.meaning: He who pervades everything; from the root 'viṣ' meaning to enter and permeate all of creation

names.name: वषट्कारः
names.meaning: He for whose worship the sacrificial exclamation 'vaṣaṭ' is uttered during Vedic rituals

names.name: भूतभव्यभवत्प्रभुः
names.meaning: The Lord and master of past, future, and present; the sovereign ruler of all time

names.name: भूतकृत्
names.meaning: The creator of all beings; He who brings all living entities into existence

names.name: भूतभृत्
names.meaning: The sustainer of all beings; He who nourishes and supports all that exists

names.name: भावः
names.meaning: Pure existence itself; He who is the essence of all that truly is

names.name: भूतात्मा
names.meaning: The inner Self of all beings; the indwelling spirit present in every creature

names.name: भूतभावनः
names.meaning: He who causes all beings to manifest and flourish; the originator and nurturer of creation

verses.sanskritDevanagari:
पूतात्मा परमात्मा च मुक्तानां परमा गतिः ।
अव्ययः पुरुषः साक्षी क्षेत्रज्ञोऽक्षर एव च ॥ २॥
verses.transliteration:
pūtātmā paramātmā ca muktānāṃ paramā gatiḥ |
avyayaḥ puruṣaḥ sākṣī kṣetrajño'kṣara eva ca || 2 ||

names.name: पूतात्मा
names.meaning: He whose nature is supremely pure; the Self untouched by any impurity or blemish

names.name: परमात्मा
names.meaning: The Supreme Self; the highest Atman who transcends all individual souls

names.name: मुक्तानां परमा गतिः
names.meaning: The supreme goal of the liberated; the final destination attained by those who achieve moksha

names.name: अव्ययः
names.meaning: The imperishable; He who is not subject to any change, decay, or diminution

names.name: पुरुषः
names.meaning: The Supreme Person; He who dwells in the body-city or who existed before all creation

names.name: साक्षी
names.meaning: The eternal witness; He who directly observes everything without being affected

names.name: क्षेत्रज्ञः
names.meaning: The knower of the field; He who knows all bodies and the experiences within them

names.name: अक्षरः
names.meaning: The indestructible; He who never perishes and from whom the imperishable syllable Om derives

verses.sanskritDevanagari:
योगो योगविदां नेता प्रधानपुरुषेश्वरः ।
नारसिंहवपुः श्रीमान्केशवः पुरुषोत्तमः ॥ ३॥
verses.transliteration:
yogo yogavidāṃ netā pradhānapuruṣeśvaraḥ |
nārasiṃhavapuḥ śrīmānkeśavaḥ puruṣottamaḥ || 3 ||

names.name: योगः
names.meaning: He who is realized through yoga; the one attainable by the means of meditation and union

names.name: योगविदां नेता
names.meaning: The guide of those who know yoga; the supreme leader of all realized yogis

names.name: प्रधानपुरुषेश्वरः
names.meaning: The Lord of both pradhana (primordial matter) and purusha (the conscious self)

names.name: नारसिंहवपुः
names.meaning: He whose form is that of Narasimha, the divine man-lion incarnation

names.name: श्रीमान्
names.meaning: He who is always endowed with Shri (Lakshmi); the possessor of all divine splendor and wealth

names.name: केशवः
names.meaning: He who has beautiful flowing hair; or He who is the combined form of Brahma (Ka), Shiva (Isha), and Vishnu

names.name: पुरुषोत्तमः
names.meaning: The Supreme Person; the best among all beings, transcending both the perishable and imperishable

verses.sanskritDevanagari:
सर्वः शर्वः शिवः स्थाणुर्भूतादिर्निधिरव्ययः ।
सम्भवो भावनो भर्ता प्रभवः प्रभुरीश्वरः ॥ ४॥
verses.transliteration:
sarvaḥ śarvaḥ śivaḥ sthāṇurbhūtādirnidhiravyayaḥ |
sambhavo bhāvano bhartā prabhavaḥ prabhurīśvaraḥ || 4 ||

names.name: सर्वः
names.meaning: He who is everything; the all-encompassing reality from whom nothing is separate

names.name: शर्वः
names.meaning: He who destroys all sins and afflictions; the remover of suffering

names.name: शिवः
names.meaning: The auspicious one; He who is eternally pure and the bestower of supreme blessedness

names.name: स्थाणुः
names.meaning: The immovable and firm; He who is eternally steady and unchanging like a pillar

names.name: भूतादिः
names.meaning: The origin of all beings; the primordial cause from whom the five elements arise

names.name: निधिरव्ययः
names.meaning: The imperishable treasure; the inexhaustible repository in whom all beings rest during dissolution

names.name: सम्भवः
names.meaning: He who manifests at will for the protection of dharma; the source of all manifestation

names.name: भावनः
names.meaning: He who generates and gives existence to all beings; the producer of everything

names.name: भर्ता
names.meaning: The supporter and sustainer; He who bears and maintains the entire creation

names.name: प्रभवः
names.meaning: The source of creation; He from whom all beings originate and emerge

names.name: प्रभुः
names.meaning: The almighty Lord; He who possesses supreme power and sovereignty over all

names.name: ईश्वरः
names.meaning: The supreme ruler; He who has unlimited lordship and governs all existence

verses.sanskritDevanagari:
स्वयम्भूः शम्भुरादित्यः पुष्कराक्षो महास्वनः ।
अनादिनिधनो धाता विधाता धातुरुत्तमः ॥ ५॥
verses.transliteration:
svayambhūḥ śambhurādityaḥ puṣkarākṣo mahāsvanaḥ |
anādinidhanō dhātā vidhātā dhāturuttamaḥ || 5 ||

names.name: स्वयम्भूः
names.meaning: The self-existent; He who manifests by His own will without any external cause

names.name: शम्भुः
names.meaning: He who bestows happiness and auspiciousness; the source of divine bliss

names.name: आदित्यः
names.meaning: The son of Aditi; He who shines like the golden sun and is the radiance within the solar orb

names.name: पुष्कराक्षः
names.meaning: He whose eyes are like the lotus; possessing beautiful, all-seeing lotus-petal eyes

names.name: महास्वनः
names.meaning: He of the great sound; He whose voice is the Vedas and whose call resonates through all creation

names.name: अनादिनिधनः
names.meaning: He who has neither beginning nor end; the eternal reality beyond birth and death

names.name: धाता
names.meaning: The creator and sustainer; He who supports all beings and establishes the cosmos

names.name: विधाता
names.meaning: The ordainer of destinies; He who dispenses the fruits of karma to all beings

names.name: धातुरुत्तमः
names.meaning: The most excellent foundation; the supreme substratum upon which all existence rests

verses.sanskritDevanagari:
अप्रमेयो हृषीकेशः पद्मनाभोऽमरप्रभुः ।
विश्वकर्मा मनुस्त्वष्टा स्थविष्ठः स्थविरो ध्रुवः ॥ ६॥
verses.transliteration:
aprameyo hṛṣīkeśaḥ padmanābho'maraprabhuḥ |
viśvakarmā manuṣṭvaṣṭā sthaviṣṭhaḥ sthaviro dhruvaḥ || 6 ||

names.name: अप्रमेयः
names.meaning: He who cannot be measured or defined by any means of knowledge; beyond all proof and perception

names.name: हृषीकेशः
names.meaning: The Lord of the senses; He who controls and directs all sense organs of every being

names.name: पद्मनाभः
names.meaning: He from whose navel the cosmic lotus emerged, giving birth to Brahma and the universe

names.name: अमरप्रभुः
names.meaning: The Lord of the immortal gods; the supreme master of all the devas

names.name: विश्वकर्मा
names.meaning: The architect of the universe; He whose creative power fashions the entire cosmos

names.name: मनुः
names.meaning: The great thinker; He who is the essence of sacred thought and the Vedic mantras

names.name: त्वष्टा
names.meaning: The shaper and fashioner; He who reduces all beings to their subtle state during dissolution

names.name: स्थविष्ठः
names.meaning: The supremely vast; He who is the most massive and colossal being in existence

names.name: स्थविरः
names.meaning: The most ancient; the primeval one who has existed since before all creation

names.name: ध्रुवः
names.meaning: The fixed and immovable; He who remains eternally constant and unchangeable

verses.sanskritDevanagari:
अग्राह्यः शाश्वतः कृष्णो लोहिताक्षः प्रतर्दनः ।
प्रभूतस्त्रिककुब्धाम पवित्रं मङ्गलं परम्॥ ७॥
verses.transliteration:
agrāhyaḥ śāśvataḥ kṛṣṇo lohitākṣaḥ pratardanaḥ |
prabhūtastrikakubdhāma pavitraṃ maṅgalaṃ param || 7 ||

names.name: अग्राह्यः
names.meaning: He who cannot be grasped by the senses or the mind; beyond the reach of ordinary perception

names.name: शाश्वतः
names.meaning: The eternal; He who exists permanently through all cycles of creation and dissolution

names.name: कृष्णः
names.meaning: The dark-complexioned one; He whose existence is pure bliss, from 'kṛṣ' (existence) and 'ṇa' (bliss)

names.name: लोहिताक्षः
names.meaning: The red-eyed one; He whose eyes are tinged with the beautiful red of a lotus petal

names.name: प्रतर्दनः
names.meaning: The great destroyer; He who annihilates all beings at the time of cosmic dissolution

names.name: प्रभूतः
names.meaning: The abundantly great; He who overflows with excellence and supreme qualities

names.name: त्रिककुब्धाम
names.meaning: He who is the abode and support of the three quarters of the universe (earth, heaven, space)

names.name: पवित्रम्
names.meaning: The supremely purifying; He by whose remembrance all sins and impurities are cleansed

names.name: मङ्गलं परम्
names.meaning: The supreme auspiciousness itself; the highest source of all that is good and blessed

verses.sanskritDevanagari:
ईशानः प्राणदः प्राणो ज्येष्ठः श्रेष्ठः प्रजापतिः ।
हिरण्यगर्भो भूगर्भो माधवो मधुसूदनः ॥ ८॥
verses.transliteration:
īśānaḥ prāṇadaḥ prāṇo jyeṣṭhaḥ śreṣṭhaḥ prajāpatiḥ |
hiraṇyagarbho bhūgarbho mādhavo madhusūdanaḥ || 8 ||

names.name: ईशानः
names.meaning: The supreme controller; He who rules and governs all beings without any constraint

names.name: प्राणदः
names.meaning: The giver of life-breath; He who bestows prāṇa upon all living beings

names.name: प्राणः
names.meaning: Life itself; the vital breath that animates and sustains all existence

names.name: ज्येष्ठः
names.meaning: The eldest and most ancient; the foremost being who existed before everything

names.name: श्रेष्ठः
names.meaning: The most praiseworthy; the supremely excellent one surpassing all others in glory

names.name: प्रजापतिः
names.meaning: The Lord of all creatures; the progenitor and protector of all living beings

names.name: हिरण्यगर्भः
names.meaning: He who dwells in the golden cosmic egg; the golden-wombed source of the created universe

names.name: भूगर्भः
names.meaning: He who holds the earth within Himself; the one in whose womb the world rests

names.name: माधवः
names.meaning: The consort of Ma (Lakshmi); or the descendant of the Madhu clan, the Lord of knowledge and silence

names.name: मधुसूदनः
names.meaning: The slayer of the demon Madhu; He who destroys the intoxication of ignorance

verses.sanskritDevanagari:
ईश्वरो विक्रमी धन्वी मेधावी विक्रमः क्रमः ।
अनुत्तमो दुराधर्षः कृतज्ञः कृतिरात्मवान्॥ ९॥
verses.transliteration:
īśvaro vikramī dhanvī medhāvī vikramaḥ kramaḥ |
anuttamo durādharṣaḥ kṛtajñaḥ kṛtirātmavān || 9 ||

names.name: ईश्वरः
names.meaning: The omnipotent Lord; He who possesses unlimited sovereign power over the cosmos

names.name: विक्रमी
names.meaning: He of mighty valor; the courageous one who measured the three worlds with His strides as Vamana

names.name: धन्वी
names.meaning: He who wields the great bow Sharnga; the divine archer of supreme skill

names.name: मेधावी
names.meaning: He of supreme intelligence; possessing infinite wisdom that comprehends all things at once

names.name: विक्रमः
names.meaning: He who is the stride of power; whose three steps pervaded the entire universe as Trivikrama

names.name: क्रमः
names.meaning: He who is the progression of all existence; the sequential order underlying the cosmos

names.name: अनुत्तमः
names.meaning: He than whom there is none greater; the unsurpassed and incomparable supreme being

names.name: दुराधर्षः
names.meaning: He who cannot be assailed by anyone; the invincible one whom none can overpower

names.name: कृतज्ञः
names.meaning: He who knows all that has been done; the grateful one who remembers even the smallest good deed

names.name: कृतिः
names.meaning: He who is the action itself; the very essence and power behind all deeds in creation

names.name: आत्मवान्
names.meaning: He who is established in His own greatness; the self-possessed one who depends on nothing else

verses.sanskritDevanagari:
सुरेशः शरणं शर्म विश्वरेताः प्रजाभवः ।
अहः संवत्सरो व्यालः प्रत्ययः सर्वदर्शनः ॥ १०॥
verses.transliteration:
sureśaḥ śaraṇaṃ śarma viśvaretāḥ prajābhavaḥ |
ahaḥ saṃvatsaro vyālaḥ pratyayaḥ sarvadarśanaḥ || 10 ||

names.name: सुरेशः
names.meaning: The Lord of the gods; the supreme ruler whom all the devas worship and obey

names.name: शरणम्
names.meaning: The ultimate refuge; He who is the shelter and sanctuary for all who seek liberation

names.name: शर्म
names.meaning: He who is supreme bliss; the embodiment of happiness and divine joy

names.name: विश्वरेताः
names.meaning: The seed of the universe; He who is the primal cause from which the entire cosmos germinates

names.name: प्रजाभवः
names.meaning: He from whom all progeny and beings come into existence; the source of all birth

names.name: अहः
names.meaning: He who is the luminous day; the embodiment of radiant light that dispels darkness

names.name: संवत्सरः
names.meaning: He who is time itself; the year and all cyclical time in whom all beings dwell

names.name: व्यालः
names.meaning: He who is unapproachable like a great serpent; impossible to capture or restrain

names.name: प्रत्ययः
names.meaning: He who is the basis of all cognition and faith; the ground of all conviction and trust

names.name: सर्वदर्शनः
names.meaning: He who sees everything; the all-perceiving one from whom nothing is ever hidden

verses.sanskritDevanagari:
अजः सर्वेश्वरः सिद्धः सिद्धिः सर्वादिरच्युतः ।
वृषाकपिरमेयात्मा सर्वयोगविनिःसृतः ॥ ११॥
verses.transliteration:
ajaḥ sarveśvaraḥ siddhaḥ siddhiḥ sarvādiracyutaḥ |
vṛṣākapir ameyātmā sarvayogaviniḥsṛtaḥ || 11 ||

names.name: अजः
names.meaning: The unborn; He who has no origin and was never brought into being by any cause

names.name: सर्वेश्वरः
names.meaning: The Lord of all; the supreme sovereign who rules over every being and every realm

names.name: सिद्धः
names.meaning: The perfected one; He who is eternally accomplished and complete in all respects

names.name: सिद्धिः
names.meaning: The attainment itself; He who is the fruit of all spiritual practice and perfection

names.name: सर्वादिः
names.meaning: The origin of all; the first cause and primordial source of everything that exists

names.name: अच्युतः
names.meaning: He who never falls from His nature; the infallible one who never declines from His glory

names.name: वृषाकपिः
names.meaning: He who showers dharma (Vṛṣa) and is the great boar (Kapi); or He who fulfills righteous desires

names.name: अमेयात्मा
names.meaning: He whose nature is immeasurable; the Self that cannot be comprehended by any finite mind

names.name: सर्वयोगविनिःसृतः
names.meaning: He who is entirely free from all bondage; liberated from every connection to the material world

verses.sanskritDevanagari:
वसुर्वसुमनाः सत्यः समात्माऽसम्मितः समः ।
अमोघः पुण्डरीकाक्षो वृषकर्मा वृषाकृतिः ॥ १२॥
verses.transliteration:
vasurvasumanāḥ satyaḥ samātmā'sammitaḥ samaḥ |
amoghaḥ puṇḍarīkākṣo vṛṣakarmā vṛṣākṛtiḥ || 12 ||

names.name: वसुः
names.meaning: He who is the indwelling wealth of all; the divine treasure who resides in all beings as their essence

names.name: वसुमनाः
names.meaning: He whose mind is pure like gold; or He who has a benevolent mind that wills good for all

names.name: सत्यः
names.meaning: He who is Truth itself; the absolute reality that alone truly exists

names.name: समात्मा
names.meaning: He who is equally present in all; the impartial Self identical in every being

names.name: असम्मितः
names.meaning: He who is incomparable; the unequalled one whom nothing can match or measure

names.name: समः
names.meaning: The equanimous one; He who regards all beings with equal vision, without partiality

names.name: अमोघः
names.meaning: He whose acts are never futile; the infallible one whose every action bears fruit

names.name: पुण्डरीकाक्षः
names.meaning: He whose eyes are like white lotuses; the beautiful-eyed one who dwells in the heart-lotus

names.name: वृषकर्मा
names.meaning: He whose every action is righteous; the one whose deeds are dharma itself

names.name: वृषाकृतिः
names.meaning: He whose form is dharma; the embodiment of righteousness in every aspect of His being

verses.sanskritDevanagari:
रुद्रो बहुशिरा बभ्रुर्विश्वयोनिः शुचिश्रवाः ।
अमृतः शाश्वतस्थाणुर्वरारोहो महातपाः ॥ १३॥
verses.transliteration:
rudro bahuśirā babhrurviśvayoniḥ śuciśravāḥ |
amṛtaḥ śāśvatasthāṇurvarāroho mahātapāḥ || 13 ||

names.name: रुद्रः
names.meaning: He who makes all beings weep at the time of cosmic dissolution; or He who drives away sorrow

names.name: बहुशिराः
names.meaning: He of many heads; the cosmic being whose heads are countless, as described in the Purusha Sukta

names.name: बभ्रुः
names.meaning: He who supports the entire world; the sustainer who bears all beings

names.name: विश्वयोनिः
names.meaning: The womb of the universe; the ultimate source from which all creation emerges

names.name: शुचिश्रवाः
names.meaning: He whose fame is pure and sacred; He who is known through the pure words of the Vedas

names.name: अमृतः
names.meaning: The immortal; He who is deathless and is the nectar of eternal life

names.name: शाश्वतस्थाणुः
names.meaning: The eternally firm one; He who is both everlasting and immovable

names.name: वरारोहः
names.meaning: He whose lap is the most excellent refuge; the supreme destination for all seekers

names.name: महातपाः
names.meaning: He of great austerity; the supreme ascetic whose tapas sustains the cosmos

verses.sanskritDevanagari:
सर्वगः सर्वविद्भानुर्विष्वक्सेनो जनार्दनः ।
वेदो वेदविदव्यङ्गो वेदाङ्गो वेदवित् कविः ॥ १४॥
verses.transliteration:
sarvagaḥ sarvavidbhānurviṣvakseno janārdanaḥ |
vedo vedavidavyaṅgo vedāṅgo vedavit kaviḥ || 14 ||

names.name: सर्वगः
names.meaning: He who pervades and reaches everywhere; the omnipresent one who permeates all space and time

names.name: सर्वविद्भानुः
names.meaning: The omniscient radiance; He who knows all and shines with the light of complete knowledge

names.name: विष्वक्सेनः
names.meaning: He whose armies are spread in all directions; the commander whose forces pervade the cosmos

names.name: जनार्दनः
names.meaning: He who torments the wicked; or He whom people approach for liberation and worldly desires

names.name: वेदः
names.meaning: He who is the Vedas themselves; the embodiment of all sacred knowledge

names.name: वेदवित्
names.meaning: He who knows the Vedas; the supreme knower of all scripture and sacred truth

names.name: अव्यङ्गः
names.meaning: He who has no imperfection; the one whose form and nature are complete and flawless

names.name: वेदाङ्गः
names.meaning: He whose limbs are the Vedas; the one from whose body the sacred scriptures emanate

names.name: वेदवित्
names.meaning: He who contemplates the meaning of the Vedas; the one who truly understands Vedic wisdom

names.name: कविः
names.meaning: The omniscient poet-seer; He who sees past, present, and future with perfect vision

verses.sanskritDevanagari:
लोकाध्यक्षः सुराध्यक्षो धर्माध्यक्षः कृताकृतः ।
चतुरात्मा चतुर्व्यूहश्चतुर्दंष्ट्रश्चतुर्भुजः ॥ १५॥
verses.transliteration:
lokādhyakṣaḥ surādhyakṣo dharmādhyakṣaḥ kṛtākṛtaḥ |
caturātmā caturvyūhaścaturdaṃṣṭraścaturbhujaḥ || 15 ||

names.name: लोकाध्यक्षः
names.meaning: The presiding Lord of all worlds; the overseer who supervises all the realms of existence

names.name: सुराध्यक्षः
names.meaning: The presiding Lord of the gods; the sovereign to whom all devas answer

names.name: धर्माध्यक्षः
names.meaning: The presiding Lord of dharma; He who oversees the moral order of the universe

names.name: कृताकृतः
names.meaning: He who is both the manifest effect and the unmanifest cause; the formed and the formless

names.name: चतुरात्मा
names.meaning: He of four forms; the one who manifests as Vasudeva, Sankarshana, Pradyumna, and Aniruddha

names.name: चतुर्व्यूहः
names.meaning: He who manifests in four emanations (vyuhas) for creation, preservation, and liberation

names.name: चतुर्दंष्ट्रः
names.meaning: He of four fangs; the Narasimha form with terrible tusks that destroy evil

names.name: चतुर्भुजः
names.meaning: The four-armed one; He who holds the conch, discus, mace, and lotus in His four hands

verses.sanskritDevanagari:
भ्राजिष्णुर्भोजनं भोक्ता सहिष्णुर्जगदादिजः ।
अनघो विजयो जेता विश्वयोनिः पुनर्वसुः ॥ १६॥
verses.transliteration:
bhrājiṣṇurbhojanaṃ bhoktā sahiṣṇurjagadādijaḥ |
anagho vijayo jetā viśvayoniḥ punarvasuḥ || 16 ||

names.name: भ्राजिष्णुः
names.meaning: The effulgent one; He who constantly shines with divine self-luminous radiance

names.name: भोजनम्
names.meaning: He who is the food and nourishment of all; the sustenance that maintains all beings

names.name: भोक्ता
names.meaning: The enjoyer; He who experiences the results of all actions as the indwelling Self

names.name: सहिष्णुः
names.meaning: He who endures all with infinite patience; the supremely forbearing one

names.name: जगदादिजः
names.meaning: He who was born at the beginning of the universe; the first being from whom creation unfolds

names.name: अनघः
names.meaning: The sinless one; He who is entirely free from any fault, defect, or impurity

names.name: विजयः
names.meaning: He who is victorious in all; the one who conquers all worlds and beings through His supreme power

names.name: जेता
names.meaning: The conqueror; He who is ever triumphant over all opposing forces

names.name: विश्वयोनिः
names.meaning: The cause of the universe; He who is the womb from which all worlds are born (repeated to emphasize)

names.name: पुनर्वसुः
names.meaning: He who dwells again and again; the one who repeatedly takes birth for the sake of dharma

verses.sanskritDevanagari:
उपेन्द्रो वामनः प्रांशुरमोघः शुचिरूर्जितः ।
अतीन्द्रः सङ्ग्रहः सर्गो धृतात्मा नियमो यमः ॥ १७॥
verses.transliteration:
upendro vāmanaḥ prāṃśuramoghaḥ śucirūrjitaḥ |
atīndraḥ saṅgrahaḥ sargo dhṛtātmā niyamo yamaḥ || 17 ||

names.name: उपेन्द्रः
names.meaning: The younger brother of Indra; Vamana who appeared as Aditi's son to reclaim the heavens

names.name: वामनः
names.meaning: The dwarf incarnation; He who appeared small but measured the three worlds with His strides

names.name: प्रांशुः
names.meaning: The tall and lofty one; He who grew to cosmic proportions from His Vamana form

names.name: अमोघः
names.meaning: He whose actions are never in vain; the infallible one whose every deed bears fruit

names.name: शुचिः
names.meaning: The pure one; He who purifies all who remember, praise, or worship Him

names.name: ऊर्जितः
names.meaning: He of immense strength; the one possessed of infinite energy and power

names.name: अतीन्द्रः
names.meaning: He who surpasses Indra; the one who transcends the king of the gods in power and glory

names.name: सङ्ग्रहः
names.meaning: He who gathers and holds all together; the force that binds the cosmos in unity

names.name: सर्गः
names.meaning: He who is creation itself; the power of projection that brings the universe into being

names.name: धृतात्मा
names.meaning: He who is self-sustaining; the one who supports Himself by His own power without any aid

names.name: नियमः
names.meaning: He who is the cosmic law and discipline; the regulating principle governing all existence

names.name: यमः
names.meaning: He who controls and restrains; the inner controller who governs all beings from within

verses.sanskritDevanagari:
वेद्यो वैद्यः सदायोगी वीरहा माधवो मधुः ।
अतीन्द्रियो महामायो महोत्साहो महाबलः ॥ १८॥
verses.transliteration:
vedyo vaidyaḥ sadāyogī vīrahā mādhavo madhuḥ |
atīndriyo mahāmāyo mahotsāho mahābalaḥ || 18 ||

names.name: वेद्यः
names.meaning: He who is to be known; the ultimate object of all knowledge and spiritual enquiry

names.name: वैद्यः
names.meaning: The supreme physician; He who cures the disease of worldly existence (samsara)

names.name: सदायोगी
names.meaning: The eternal yogi; He who is perpetually united with all beings and never separate from them

names.name: वीरहा
names.meaning: The slayer of heroic demons; He who destroys powerful enemies of dharma

names.name: माधवः
names.meaning: The Lord of knowledge; consort of Ma (Lakshmi), or descendant of the Madhu dynasty

names.name: मधुः
names.meaning: He who is sweet as honey; the one whose nature is bliss itself

names.name: अतीन्द्रियः
names.meaning: He who is beyond the senses; the transcendent reality that cannot be perceived through sensory organs

names.name: महामायः
names.meaning: He of great maya; the wielder of the cosmic power of illusion that creates the phenomenal world

names.name: महोत्साहः
names.meaning: He of great enthusiasm; the one possessed of boundless energy and enterprise in all His activities

names.name: महाबलः
names.meaning: He of immense strength; the one whose power is unlimited and irresistible

verses.sanskritDevanagari:
महाबुद्धिर्महावीर्यो महाशक्तिर्महाद्युतिः ।
अनिर्देश्यवपुः श्रीमानमेयात्मा महाद्रिधृक् ॥ १९॥
verses.transliteration:
mahābuddhirmahāvīryo mahāśaktirmahādyutiḥ |
anirdeśyavapuḥ śrīmānameyātmā mahādridhṛk || 19 ||

names.name: महाबुद्धिः
names.meaning: He of supreme intelligence; the one whose understanding encompasses all knowledge at once

names.name: महावीर्यः
names.meaning: He of supreme valour; the one whose heroic power and virility are infinite

names.name: महाशक्तिः
names.meaning: He of supreme power; the one who possesses all forms of energy — creative, sustaining, and dissolving

names.name: महाद्युतिः
names.meaning: He of supreme splendour; the one whose brilliance illuminates and surpasses all other luminaries

names.name: अनिर्देश्यवपुः
names.meaning: He whose form cannot be described; the one whose body transcends all categories of speech and thought

names.name: श्रीमान्
names.meaning: He who is endowed with all divine auspiciousness; the possessor of Shri in every sense

names.name: अमेयात्मा
names.meaning: He whose Self is immeasurable; the one whose nature cannot be fathomed by any means

names.name: महाद्रिधृक्
names.meaning: He who lifted the great mountain; Krishna who held Govardhana to protect the people of Vraja

verses.sanskritDevanagari:
महेष्वासो महीभर्ता श्रीनिवासः सतां गतिः ।
अनिरुद्धः सुरानन्दो गोविन्दो गोविदां पतिः ॥ २०॥
verses.transliteration:
maheṣvāso mahībhartā śrīnivāsaḥ satāṃ gatiḥ |
aniruddhaḥ surānando govindo govidāṃ patiḥ || 20 ||

names.name: महेष्वासः
names.meaning: He who wields the great bow; the divine archer bearing the mighty Sharnga bow

names.name: महीभर्ता
names.meaning: The supporter of the earth; He who as Varaha rescued and upholds the earth

names.name: श्रीनिवासः
names.meaning: The abode of Shri (Lakshmi); He in whose chest the Goddess of fortune eternally resides

names.name: सतां गतिः
names.meaning: The refuge and goal of the righteous; the supreme destination of all good and virtuous beings

names.name: अनिरुद्धः
names.meaning: He who cannot be obstructed by anyone; the irresistible one whom no force can restrain

names.name: सुरानन्दः
names.meaning: The bliss of the gods; He who brings joy and delight to all the celestial beings

names.name: गोविन्दः
names.meaning: He who is found through the Vedas (Go = words); or the protector of cows and the earth

names.name: गोविदां पतिः
names.meaning: The Lord of those who know the Vedas; the master of all knowers of sacred speech

verses.sanskritDevanagari:
मरीचिर्दमनो हंसः सुपर्णो भुजगोत्तमः ।
हिरण्यनाभः सुतपाः पद्मनाभः प्रजापतिः ॥ २१॥
verses.transliteration:
marīcirdamano haṃsaḥ suparṇo bhujagottamaḥ |
hiraṇyanābhaḥ sutapāḥ padmanābhaḥ prajāpatiḥ || 21 ||

names.name: मरीचिः
names.meaning: He who is a ray of light; the effulgent one who shines like the luminous rays of the sun

names.name: दमनः
names.meaning: The subduer; He who restrains and disciplines the wicked and those who stray from dharma

names.name: हंसः
names.meaning: The divine swan; He who discriminates between the real and unreal, as a swan separates milk from water

names.name: सुपर्णः
names.meaning: He of beautiful wings; the one who carries souls across the ocean of samsara like the divine Garuda

names.name: भुजगोत्तमः
names.meaning: The best among serpents; He who reclines on Ananta Shesha, the supreme cosmic serpent

names.name: हिरण्यनाभः
names.meaning: He with a golden navel; the one from whose golden navel-lotus the universe manifests

names.name: सुतपाः
names.meaning: He of excellent austerity; the one whose tapas is the most sublime and powerful

names.name: पद्मनाभः
names.meaning: He from whose navel the cosmic lotus springs; Vishnu from whom Brahma and creation emerge

names.name: प्रजापतिः
names.meaning: The Lord of all beings; the progenitor and supreme ruler of all creatures

verses.sanskritDevanagari:
अमृत्युः सर्वदृक् सिंहः सन्धाता सन्धिमान् स्थिरः ।
अजो दुर्मर्षणः शास्ता विश्रुतात्मा सुरारिहा ॥ २२॥
verses.transliteration:
amṛtyuḥ sarvadṛk siṃhaḥ sandhātā sandhimān sthiraḥ |
ajo durmarṣaṇaḥ śāstā viśrutātmā surārihā || 22 ||

names.name: अमृत्युः
names.meaning: He who is deathless; the one for whom there is no death and who liberates others from death

names.name: सर्वदृक्
names.meaning: The all-seeing one; He who perceives everything simultaneously with His infinite vision

names.name: सिंहः
names.meaning: The lion; He who is supremely powerful and fearless like the king of beasts

names.name: सन्धाता
names.meaning: The unifier; He who joins beings with the fruits of their actions and connects cause to effect

names.name: सन्धिमान्
names.meaning: He who is always in union; the one perpetually connected with His devotees and with cosmic order

names.name: स्थिरः
names.meaning: The steadfast one; He who is eternally firm, stable, and immovable in His nature

names.name: अजः
names.meaning: The unborn; He who has no origin and is never created, existing eternally

names.name: दुर्मर्षणः
names.meaning: He who cannot be vanquished; the one who is impossible to overpower or conquer in any way

names.name: शास्ता
names.meaning: The teacher and ruler; He who instructs all beings and governs the cosmos through dharma

names.name: विश्रुतात्मा
names.meaning: He whose glory is heard everywhere; the one whose fame and nature are renowned throughout the Vedas

names.name: सुरारिहा
names.meaning: The destroyer of the enemies of the gods; He who slays the demons who oppose divine order

verses.sanskritDevanagari:
गुरुर्गुरुतमो धाम सत्यः सत्यपराक्रमः ।
निमिषोऽनिमिषः स्रग्वी वाचस्पतिरुदारधीः ॥ २३॥
verses.transliteration:
gururgurutamo dhāma satyaḥ satyaparākramaḥ |
imiṣo'nimiṣaḥ sragvī vācaspatirudāradhīḥ || 23 ||

names.name: गुरुः
names.meaning: The supreme teacher; He who dispels the darkness of ignorance and reveals the light of truth

names.name: गुरुतमः
names.meaning: The greatest of all teachers; the most venerable preceptor who transcends all other guides

names.name: धाम
names.meaning: The supreme abode and radiance; the luminous dwelling of ultimate truth and bliss

names.name: सत्यः
names.meaning: He who is Truth itself; the absolute reality that alone truly and eternally exists

names.name: सत्यपराक्रमः
names.meaning: He whose valour is always true and unfailing; the one whose heroic power never fails

names.name: निमिषः
names.meaning: He who winks; the one who appears to close His eyes in the form of cosmic sleep (yoga-nidra)

names.name: अनिमिषः
names.meaning: He who never blinks; the ever-vigilant one whose watchful gaze never ceases

names.name: स्रग्वी
names.meaning: He who wears a divine garland; the one adorned with the Vaijayanti garland of five gems

names.name: वाचस्पतिः
names.meaning: The Lord of speech; the master of eloquence from whom all words and their meanings originate

names.name: उदारधीः
names.meaning: He of noble and generous intellect; the one whose understanding is magnanimous and sublime

verses.sanskritDevanagari:
अग्रणीर्ग्रामणीः श्रीमान् न्यायो नेता समीरणः ।
सहस्रमूर्धा विश्वात्मा सहस्राक्षः सहस्रपात् ॥ २४॥
verses.transliteration:
agraṇīrgrāmaṇīḥ śrīmān nyāyo netā samīraṇaḥ |
sahasramūrdhā viśvātmā sahasrākṣaḥ sahasrapāt || 24 ||

names.name: अग्रणीः
names.meaning: He who leads all forward; the foremost guide who takes beings toward liberation

names.name: ग्रामणीः
names.meaning: The leader of the host; the commander who guides the community of seekers

names.name: श्रीमान्
names.meaning: He who possesses all divine wealth and glory; the eternally prosperous one

names.name: न्यायः
names.meaning: He who is justice itself; the embodiment of logic and righteous judgement

names.name: नेता
names.meaning: The guide and leader; He who directs all beings along their destined paths

names.name: समीरणः
names.meaning: He who sets everything in motion; the cosmic wind that animates all activity

names.name: सहस्रमूर्धा
names.meaning: He of a thousand heads; the cosmic Purusha described in the Purusha Sukta as having infinite heads

names.name: विश्वात्मा
names.meaning: The soul of the universe; the Self that dwells as the innermost essence of all that exists

names.name: सहस्राक्षः
names.meaning: He of a thousand eyes; the all-seeing one with infinite organs of perception

names.name: सहस्रपात्
names.meaning: He of a thousand feet; the cosmic being who stands and walks everywhere simultaneously

verses.sanskritDevanagari:
आवर्तनो निवृत्तात्मा संवृतः सम्प्रमर्दनः ।
अहः संवर्तको वह्निरनिलो धरणीधरः ॥ २५॥
verses.transliteration:
āvartano nivṛttātmā saṃvṛtaḥ sampramardanaḥ |
ahaḥ saṃvartako vahniranilo dharaṇīdharaḥ || 25 ||

names.name: आवर्तनः
names.meaning: He who turns the wheel of samsara; the one who keeps the cycle of creation revolving

names.name: निवृत्तात्मा
names.meaning: He whose Self is completely withdrawn from worldly attachments; the fully liberated one

names.name: संवृतः
names.meaning: He who is concealed; the one who is hidden from those lacking devotion and spiritual vision

names.name: सम्प्रमर्दनः
names.meaning: He who thoroughly crushes; the destroyer who completely annihilates enemies and evil

names.name: अहः संवर्तकः
names.meaning: He who turns day into night; the cosmic force that brings about the dissolution of time cycles

names.name: वह्निः
names.meaning: He who is fire itself; the divine flame that receives oblations and sustains the cosmic order

names.name: अनिलः
names.meaning: He who is the cosmic wind; the breath of life that pervades and animates all beings

names.name: धरणीधरः
names.meaning: The upholder of the earth; He who bears and supports the entire world

verses.sanskritDevanagari:
सुप्रसादः प्रसन्नात्मा विश्वधृग्विश्वभुग्विभुः ।
सत्कर्ता सत्कृतः साधुर्जह्नुर्नारायणो नरः ॥ २६॥
verses.transliteration:
suprasādaḥ prasannātmā viśvadhṛgviśvabhugvibhuḥ |
satkartā satkṛtaḥ sādhurjahnurnārāyaṇo naraḥ || 26 ||

names.name: सुप्रसादः
names.meaning: He who is full of gracious compassion; the one whose divine grace flows abundantly to all

names.name: प्रसन्नात्मा
names.meaning: He whose Self is ever tranquil and clear; the one who is eternally serene and joyful

names.name: विश्वधृक्
names.meaning: He who upholds the universe; the one who bears and sustains all the worlds

names.name: विश्वभुक्
names.meaning: He who enjoys and protects the universe; the one who is both the experiencer and guardian of all

names.name: विभुः
names.meaning: The all-pervading Lord; He who is present everywhere and in everything without limitation

names.name: सत्कर्ता
names.meaning: He who honours the good; the one who reveres and rewards righteous beings

names.name: सत्कृतः
names.meaning: He who is worshipped by the virtuous; the one honoured by all noble and wise beings

names.name: साधुः
names.meaning: He who is righteous and virtuous; the embodiment of goodness who acts with perfect dharma

names.name: जह्नुः
names.meaning: He who withdraws beings into Himself during dissolution; the concealer of the universe at pralaya

names.name: नारायणः
names.meaning: He who is the resting place of all beings (nara); the refuge of all souls who reside in the cosmic waters

names.name: नरः
names.meaning: The eternal man; He who is the imperishable cosmic person, the primordial Purusha

verses.sanskritDevanagari:
असङ्ख्येयोऽप्रमेयात्मा विशिष्टः शिष्टकृच्छुचिः ।
सिद्धार्थः सिद्धसङ्कल्पः सिद्धिदः सिद्धिसाधनः ॥ २७॥
verses.transliteration:
asaṅkhyeyo'prameyātmā viśiṣṭaḥ śiṣṭakṛcchuciḥ |
siddhārthaḥ siddhasaṅkalpaḥ siddhidaḥ siddhisādhanaḥ || 27 ||

names.name: असङ्ख्येयः
names.meaning: He who is innumerable; the one who cannot be counted or quantified as He is infinite

names.name: अप्रमेयात्मा
names.meaning: He whose Self cannot be measured; the one who transcends all means of proof and measurement

names.name: विशिष्टः
names.meaning: He who is distinguished above all; the one who excels in every quality and attribute

names.name: शिष्टकृत्
names.meaning: He who disciplines and civilizes; the one who establishes good conduct in the world

names.name: शुचिः
names.meaning: The pure one; He who is spotless and who purifies all who come in contact with Him

names.name: सिद्धार्थः
names.meaning: He whose purpose is always accomplished; the one who has achieved all goals and objectives

names.name: सिद्धसङ्कल्पः
names.meaning: He whose will is always fulfilled; the one whose every resolve immediately becomes reality

names.name: सिद्धिदः
names.meaning: The bestower of perfection; He who grants spiritual attainment to seekers

names.name: सिद्धिसाधनः
names.meaning: He who is the means to perfection; the one who is both the path and the instrument of spiritual accomplishment

verses.sanskritDevanagari:
वृषाही वृषभो विष्णुर्वृषपर्वा वृषोदरः ।
वर्धनो वर्धमानश्च विविक्तः श्रुतिसागरः ॥ २८॥
verses.transliteration:
vṛṣāhī vṛṣabho viṣṇurvṛṣaparvā vṛṣodaraḥ |
vardhano vardhamānaśca viviktaḥ śrutisāgaraḥ || 28 ||

names.name: वृषाही
names.meaning: He who shines through dharma; the one who radiates the brilliance of righteousness

names.name: वृषभः
names.meaning: The bull of dharma; the most excellent and powerful upholder of righteousness

names.name: विष्णुः
names.meaning: The all-pervading; He who enters everywhere and permeates the entire cosmos

names.name: वृषपर्वा
names.meaning: He who has dharma as the steps of His ladder; the one for whom righteousness forms every stage of ascent

names.name: वृषोदरः
names.meaning: He whose belly showers blessings; the one from whose core dharma and prosperity flow

names.name: वर्धनः
names.meaning: He who makes all things grow and prosper; the nourisher and augmenter of all beings

names.name: वर्धमानः
names.meaning: He who grows; the one who appears to increase in the hearts of His devotees through devotion

names.name: विविक्तः
names.meaning: He who is distinct and separate from all; the one who exists apart from the manifested world

names.name: श्रुतिसागरः
names.meaning: The ocean of the Vedas; He into whom all sacred knowledge flows and in whom it rests

verses.sanskritDevanagari:
सुभुजो दुर्धरो वाग्मी महेन्द्रो वसुदो वसुः ।
नैकरूपो बृहद्रूपः शिपिविष्टः प्रकाशनः ॥ २९॥
verses.transliteration:
subhujo durdharo vāgmī mahendro vasudo vasuḥ |
naikarūpo bṛhadrūpaḥ śipiviṣṭaḥ prakāśanaḥ || 29 ||

names.name: सुभुजः
names.meaning: He of beautiful arms; the one whose arms are graceful and protect all beings

names.name: दुर्धरः
names.meaning: He who is difficult to bear in meditation; the one whose form is hard to hold in the mind due to its magnificence

names.name: वाग्मी
names.meaning: He who is eloquent; the master of speech from whom all articulate expression derives

names.name: महेन्द्रः
names.meaning: The great Indra; He who is the lord of all lords and the supreme ruler of the heavens

names.name: वसुदः
names.meaning: The giver of wealth; He who bestows riches and prosperity upon His devotees

names.name: वसुः
names.meaning: He who is wealth itself; the ultimate treasure that all beings seek

names.name: नैकरूपः
names.meaning: He of many forms; the one who assumes innumerable shapes for the benefit of creation

names.name: बृहद्रूपः
names.meaning: He of vast form; the cosmic being whose body encompasses the entire universe

names.name: शिपिविष्टः
names.meaning: He who pervades the rays of the sun; the one who dwells within the light and permeates all radiance

names.name: प्रकाशनः
names.meaning: The illuminator; He who reveals and makes everything known through His divine light

verses.sanskritDevanagari:
ओजस्तेजोद्युतिधरः प्रकाशात्मा प्रतापनः ।
ऋद्धः स्पष्टाक्षरो मन्त्रश्चन्द्रांशुर्भास्करद्युतिः ॥ ३०॥
verses.transliteration:
ojastejodyutidharaḥ prakāśātmā pratāpanaḥ |
ṛddhaḥ spaṣṭākṣaro mantraśccandrāṃśurbhāskaradyutiḥ || 30 ||

names.name: ओजस्तेजोद्युतिधरः
names.meaning: He who possesses vitality, brilliance, and lustre; the bearer of all forms of divine energy and light

names.name: प्रकाशात्मा
names.meaning: He whose nature is luminous; the Self that is pure consciousness and self-illuminating light

names.name: प्रतापनः
names.meaning: He who scorches evil; the blazing one whose heat burns away ignorance and sin

names.name: ऋद्धः
names.meaning: He who is endowed with all prosperity; the one who overflows with every form of abundance

names.name: स्पष्टाक्षरः
names.meaning: He whose syllable (Om) is clearly manifest; the one whose sacred sound is distinctly heard by the devoted

names.name: मन्त्रः
names.meaning: He who is the sacred mantra; the one who is revealed through Vedic hymns and who protects those who meditate on Him

names.name: चन्द्रांशुः
names.meaning: He whose rays are cool like moonlight; the one who soothes and nourishes all beings with gentle radiance

names.name: भास्करद्युतिः
names.meaning: He whose splendour equals the sun; the one who blazes with the brilliance of a thousand suns

verses.sanskritDevanagari:
अमृतांशूद्भवो भानुः शशबिन्दुः सुरेश्वरः ।
औषधं जगतः सेतुः सत्यधर्मपराक्रमः ॥ ३१॥
verses.transliteration:
amṛtāṃśūdbhavo bhānuḥ śaśabinduḥ sureśvaraḥ |
auṣadhaṃ jagataḥ setuḥ satyadharmaparākramaḥ || 31 ||

names.name: अमृतांशूद्भवः
names.meaning: He from whom the nectar-rayed moon was born; the source from which the immortal nectar of the moon emerged

names.name: भानुः
names.meaning: The shining sun; He who illuminates all the worlds with His brilliant radiance

names.name: शशबिन्दुः
names.meaning: He who bears the mark of the hare (the moon); or He who controls the mind-born creation

names.name: सुरेश्वरः
names.meaning: The Lord of the gods; the sovereign deity whom all celestial beings worship

names.name: औषधम्
names.meaning: He who is the divine medicine; the supreme remedy that cures the disease of samsara

names.name: जगतः सेतुः
names.meaning: The bridge of the world; He who is the dam that upholds dharma and prevents the flood of chaos

names.name: सत्यधर्मपराक्रमः
names.meaning: He whose valour is in truth and dharma; the one whose heroic actions are always grounded in righteousness

verses.sanskritDevanagari:
भूतभव्यभवन्नाथः पवनः पावनोऽनलः ।
कामहा कामकृत्कान्तः कामः कामप्रदः प्रभुः ॥ ३२॥
verses.transliteration:
bhūtabhavyabhavannnāthaḥ pavanaḥ pāvano'nalaḥ |
kāmahā kāmakṛtkāntaḥ kāmaḥ kāmapradaḥ prabhuḥ || 32 ||

names.name: भूतभव्यभवन्नाथः
names.meaning: The Lord of past, future, and present; the sovereign master of all three periods of time

names.name: पवनः
names.meaning: He who is the purifying wind; the cosmic air that cleanses and vivifies all existence

names.name: पावनः
names.meaning: The supreme purifier; He whose very name cleanses all sins and impurities from the soul

names.name: अनलः
names.meaning: He of unlimited power and wealth; the one whose energy is inexhaustible like an eternal flame

names.name: कामहा
names.meaning: The destroyer of desires; He who annihilates selfish desires in those who surrender to Him

names.name: कामकृत्
names.meaning: The fulfiller of desires; He who grants the wishes of His devotees

names.name: कान्तः
names.meaning: He who is supremely beautiful; the most attractive being whose charm captivates all hearts

names.name: कामः
names.meaning: He who is the object of desire; the one whom all beings ultimately seek and long for

names.name: कामप्रदः
names.meaning: The bestower of desired objects; He who generously grants both worldly and spiritual wishes

names.name: प्रभुः
names.meaning: The almighty Lord; He who has supreme dominion and authority over all creation

verses.sanskritDevanagari:
युगादिकृद्युगावर्तो नैकमायो महाशनः ।
अदृश्यो व्यक्तरूपश्च सहस्रजिदनन्तजित् ॥ ३३॥
verses.transliteration:
yugādikṛdyugāvarto naikamāyo mahāśanaḥ |
adṛśyo vyaktarūpaśca sahasrajidanantajit || 33 ||

names.name: युगादिकृत्
names.meaning: The creator of the yugas; He who initiates the cosmic ages and sets the cycles of time in motion

names.name: युगावर्तः
names.meaning: He who turns the wheel of the yugas; the one who causes the cosmic ages to revolve in endless cycles

names.name: नैकमायः
names.meaning: He who possesses manifold maya; the Lord whose creative powers manifest in countless wondrous forms

names.name: महाशनः
names.meaning: The great consumer; He who devours all beings at the time of cosmic dissolution

names.name: अदृश्यः
names.meaning: The invisible one; He who cannot be perceived by ordinary eyes or the senses

names.name: व्यक्तरूपः
names.meaning: He of manifest form; though beyond perception, He reveals Himself through His divine incarnations

names.name: सहस्रजित्
names.meaning: The conqueror of thousands; He who vanquishes innumerable foes and obstacles

names.name: अनन्तजित्
names.meaning: He of infinite victories; the one whose triumphs are boundless and who is never defeated

verses.sanskritDevanagari:
इष्टोऽविशिष्टः शिष्टेष्टः शिखण्डी नहुषो वृषः ।
क्रोधहा क्रोधकृत्कर्ता विश्वबाहुर्महीधरः ॥ ३४॥
verses.transliteration:
iṣṭo'viśiṣṭaḥ śiṣṭeṣṭaḥ śikhaṇḍī nahuṣo vṛṣaḥ |
krodhahā krodhakṛtkartā viśvabāhurmahīdharaḥ || 34 ||

names.name: इष्टः
names.meaning: The beloved; He who is sought after and worshipped through Vedic sacrifices and devotion

names.name: अविशिष्टः
names.meaning: He who is impartially present everywhere; the one who exists equally in all without distinction

names.name: शिष्टेष्टः
names.meaning: He who is dear to the virtuous; the beloved Lord of the wise and the righteous

names.name: शिखण्डी
names.meaning: He who wears a peacock feather as His crown; the adorned one resplendent with divine ornaments

names.name: नहुषः
names.meaning: He who binds all beings through maya; the one who fetters living entities to the cycle of existence

names.name: वृषः
names.meaning: He who showers dharma; the embodiment of righteousness who rains down blessings upon devotees

names.name: क्रोधहा
names.meaning: The destroyer of anger; He who eradicates wrath in those who take refuge in Him

names.name: क्रोधकृत्कर्ता
names.meaning: He who generates righteous wrath against evil; the one who directs anger for the protection of dharma

names.name: विश्वबाहुः
names.meaning: He whose arms encompass the universe; the one who embraces and protects all of creation

names.name: महीधरः
names.meaning: The upholder of the earth; He who bears and sustains the world as Varaha or as the cosmic foundation

verses.sanskritDevanagari:
अच्युतः प्रथितः प्राणः प्राणदो वासवानुजः ।
अपांनिधिरधिष्ठानमप्रमत्तः प्रतिष्ठितः ॥ ३५॥
verses.transliteration:
acyutaḥ prathitaḥ prāṇaḥ prāṇado vāsavānujaḥ |
apāṃnidhiradhiṣṭhānamapramattaḥ pratiṣṭhitaḥ || 35 ||

names.name: अच्युतः
names.meaning: He who never falls from His glory; the infallible one who never declines or loses His divine nature

names.name: प्रथितः
names.meaning: The celebrated one; He whose fame and glory are widely known throughout all the worlds

names.name: प्राणः
names.meaning: The life-breath itself; the vital force that sustains and animates every living being

names.name: प्राणदः
names.meaning: The bestower of life-breath; He who grants the vital force to all creatures at the time of creation

names.name: वासवानुजः
names.meaning: The younger brother of Vasava (Indra); referring to Lord Vishnu's incarnation as Vamana

names.name: अपांनिधिः
names.meaning: The reservoir of the waters; the cosmic ocean in whom all waters find their ultimate resting place

names.name: अधिष्ठानम्
names.meaning: The supreme substratum; the foundational support upon which the entire universe is established

names.name: अप्रमत्तः
names.meaning: The ever-vigilant one; He who is never careless and always attentive to the welfare of His devotees

names.name: प्रतिष्ठितः
names.meaning: He who is firmly established in His own greatness; the self-founded one who rests in His own glory

verses.sanskritDevanagari:
स्कन्दः स्कन्दधरो धुर्यो वरदो वायुवाहनः ।
वासुदेवो बृहद्भानुरादिदेवः पुरन्दरः ॥ ३६॥
verses.transliteration:
skandaḥ skandadharo dhuryo varado vāyuvāhanaḥ |
vāsudevo bṛhadbhānurādidevaḥ purandaraḥ || 36 ||

names.name: स्कन्दः
names.meaning: He who dries up all sins; or He who flows as the nectar of divine grace upon devotees

names.name: स्कन्दधरः
names.meaning: The upholder of Skanda (Kartikeya); He who sustains the path of righteousness through the warrior-god

names.name: धुर्यः
names.meaning: The one who bears the burden; He who carries the weight of the entire universe upon Himself

names.name: वरदः
names.meaning: The grantor of boons; He who bestows the highest blessings upon those who worship Him

names.name: वायुवाहनः
names.meaning: He who drives the wind; the controller of Vayu and all the cosmic vital forces

names.name: वासुदेवः
names.meaning: The son of Vasudeva; the all-pervading Lord who dwells in all beings and in whom all beings dwell

names.name: बृहद्भानुः
names.meaning: He of immense radiance; the great luminary whose brilliance illuminates the entire cosmos

names.name: आदिदेवः
names.meaning: The primordial deity; the first among all gods from whom all divine beings originate

names.name: पुरन्दरः
names.meaning: The destroyer of enemy cities; He who shatters the strongholds of the asuras and of ignorance

verses.sanskritDevanagari:
अशोकस्तारणस्तारः शूरः शौरिर्जनेश्वरः ।
अनुकूलः शतावर्तः पद्मी पद्मनिभेक्षणः ॥ ३७॥
verses.transliteration:
aśokastāraṇastāraḥ śūraḥ śaurirjaneśvaraḥ |
anukūlaḥ śatāvartaḥ padmī padmanibhekṣaṇaḥ || 37 ||

names.name: अशोकः
names.meaning: He who is free from all sorrow; the one who dispels grief and suffering from His devotees

names.name: तारणः
names.meaning: He who enables the crossing over; the divine ferryman who helps beings traverse the ocean of samsara

names.name: तारः
names.meaning: The liberator; He who rescues beings from the cycle of birth and death and grants them moksha

names.name: शूरः
names.meaning: The valiant hero; the supremely brave one who is invincible in all cosmic battles

names.name: शौरिः
names.meaning: The descendant of the Shura dynasty; a name of Krishna indicating His illustrious warrior lineage

names.name: जनेश्वरः
names.meaning: The Lord of all people; the supreme sovereign who rules over all beings with compassion

names.name: अनुकूलः
names.meaning: He who is favorable to all; the benevolent Lord who is well-disposed toward every being

names.name: शतावर्तः
names.meaning: He who has incarnated hundreds of times; the Lord who takes countless births to protect dharma

names.name: पद्मी
names.meaning: He who holds the lotus; the Lord who carries the divine lotus as a symbol of purity and creation

names.name: पद्मनिभेक्षणः
names.meaning: He whose eyes resemble the lotus; possessing gentle, beautiful eyes like blooming lotus petals

verses.sanskritDevanagari:
पद्मनाभोऽरविन्दाक्षः पद्मगर्भः शरीरभृत् ।
महर्द्धिर्ऋद्धो वृद्धात्मा महाक्षो गरुडध्वजः ॥ ३८॥
verses.transliteration:
padmanābho'ravindākṣaḥ padmagarbhaḥ śarīrabhṛt |
maharddhirṛddho vṛddhātmā mahākṣo garuḍadhvajaḥ || 38 ||

names.name: पद्मनाभः
names.meaning: He from whose navel springs the cosmic lotus; the source from which Brahma and creation emerge

names.name: अरविन्दाक्षः
names.meaning: He whose eyes are like lotuses; the beautiful-eyed Lord who gazes upon all beings with grace

names.name: पद्मगर्भः
names.meaning: He who resides in the heart-lotus; the one who dwells within the lotus-like core of all beings

names.name: शरीरभृत्
names.meaning: The sustainer of all bodies; He who nourishes and upholds every embodied being in the universe

names.name: महर्द्धिः
names.meaning: He of great prosperity; the possessor of supreme supernatural powers and infinite abundance

names.name: ऋद्धः
names.meaning: The flourishing one; He who is endowed with all forms of abundance and divine perfection

names.name: वृद्धात्मा
names.meaning: The ancient Self; He whose Atman is the most venerable and ancient of all existences

names.name: महाक्षः
names.meaning: The great-eyed one; He who possesses vast all-seeing eyes that observe the entire creation

names.name: गरुडध्वजः
names.meaning: He whose banner bears Garuda; the Lord whose emblem is the divine eagle, king of birds

verses.sanskritDevanagari:
अतुलः शरभो भीमः समयज्ञो हविर्हरिः ।
सर्वलक्षणलक्षण्यो लक्ष्मीवान् समितिञ्जयः ॥ ३९॥
verses.transliteration:
atulaḥ śarabho bhīmaḥ samayajño havirhariḥ |
sarvalakṣaṇalakṣaṇyo lakṣmīvān samitiñjayaḥ || 39 ||

names.name: अतुलः
names.meaning: The incomparable one; He who has no equal and to whom nothing in creation can be compared

names.name: शरभः
names.meaning: He who shines as the inner light; the radiant one who illuminates the bodies of all beings

names.name: भीमः
names.meaning: The awe-inspiring one; He whose might and grandeur inspire reverent fear in all beings

names.name: समयज्ञः
names.meaning: The knower of the right time; He who understands the proper moment for every cosmic action

names.name: हविर्हरिः
names.meaning: He who receives the sacrificial oblations; the Lord who is the ultimate recipient of all Vedic offerings

names.name: सर्वलक्षणलक्षण्यः
names.meaning: He who possesses all auspicious marks; the one identifiable by every sacred sign of perfection

names.name: लक्ष्मीवान्
names.meaning: He who is always with Lakshmi; the eternal consort of the goddess of wealth, grace, and beauty

names.name: समितिञ्जयः
names.meaning: He who is victorious in battle; the invincible warrior who triumphs in every assembly and conflict

verses.sanskritDevanagari:
विक्षरो रोहितो मार्गो हेतुर्दामोदरः सहः ।
महीधरो महाभागो वेगवानमिताशनः ॥ ४०॥
verses.transliteration:
vikṣaro rohito mārgo heturdāmodaraḥ sahaḥ |
mahīdharo mahābhāgo vegavānamitāśanaḥ || 40 ||

names.name: विक्षरः
names.meaning: He who is imperishable; the one who never decays and from whom all blessings flow ceaselessly

names.name: रोहितः
names.meaning: He who is of reddish hue; the Lord who assumed the form of a great red fish to save the Vedas

names.name: मार्गः
names.meaning: The path; He who is the way to liberation, the supreme goal sought by all spiritual seekers

names.name: हेतुः
names.meaning: The ultimate cause; the first and final reason behind all creation, sustenance, and dissolution

names.name: दामोदरः
names.meaning: He who was bound with a rope around His belly; Krishna who was lovingly tied by mother Yashoda

names.name: सहः
names.meaning: He who endures all; the supremely patient one who bears everything with infinite forbearance

names.name: महीधरः
names.meaning: The bearer of the earth; He who upholds the world in His Varaha incarnation as the cosmic boar

names.name: महाभागः
names.meaning: He of supreme fortune; the most blessed one who is the source of all auspiciousness

names.name: वेगवान्
names.meaning: He of tremendous speed; the swift Lord who reaches His devotees instantly when they call

names.name: अमिताशनः
names.meaning: He of boundless appetite; the one who consumes the entire universe at the time of dissolution

verses.sanskritDevanagari:
उद्भवः क्षोभणो देवः श्रीगर्भः परमेश्वरः ।
करणं कारणं कर्ता विकर्ता गहनो गुहः ॥ ४१॥
verses.transliteration:
udbhavaḥ kṣobhaṇo devaḥ śrīgarbhaḥ parameśvaraḥ |
karaṇaṃ kāraṇaṃ kartā vikartā gahano guhaḥ || 41 ||

names.name: उद्भवः
names.meaning: The source of origin; He from whom all beings arise and who transcends all material causes

names.name: क्षोभणः
names.meaning: The agitator; He who stirs primordial nature at the beginning of creation to initiate manifestation

names.name: देवः
names.meaning: The shining one; He who is self-luminous, the source of all light and divine play

names.name: श्रीगर्भः
names.meaning: He within whom Shri (all splendor) resides; the one who carries all prosperity within Himself

names.name: परमेश्वरः
names.meaning: The supreme Lord; the highest ruler whose sovereignty extends over all realms of existence

names.name: करणम्
names.meaning: The instrument; He who is the means and the instrument through which all creation functions

names.name: कारणम्
names.meaning: The ultimate cause; the supreme reason behind all phenomena, both material and efficient

names.name: कर्ता
names.meaning: The doer; the independent agent who performs all cosmic actions through His divine will

names.name: विकर्ता
names.meaning: The transformer; He who creates the manifold diversity of forms in the universe

names.name: गहनः
names.meaning: The unfathomable; He whose true nature is profound and impenetrable to ordinary understanding

names.name: गुहः
names.meaning: He who conceals Himself; the hidden one who dwells in the secret cave of the heart

verses.sanskritDevanagari:
व्यवसायो व्यवस्थानः संस्थानः स्थानदो ध्रुवः ।
परर्द्धिः परमस्पष्टः तुष्टः पुष्टः शुभेक्षणः ॥ ४२॥
verses.transliteration:
vyavasāyo vyavasthānaḥ saṃsthānaḥ sthānado dhruvaḥ |
parardhiḥ paramaspṣṭaḥ tuṣṭaḥ puṣṭaḥ śubhekṣaṇaḥ || 42 ||

names.name: व्यवसायः
names.meaning: He who is resolute determination itself; the firm resolve that drives all purposeful action

names.name: व्यवस्थानम्
names.meaning: The foundation of order; He who establishes the laws and regulations governing the cosmos

names.name: संस्थानम्
names.meaning: The ultimate abode; the final resting place in which all beings find their supreme destination

names.name: स्थानदः
names.meaning: The giver of the right place; He who assigns to each being its proper station in the cosmic order

names.name: ध्रुवः
names.meaning: The immovable and constant; the fixed reality that remains unchanging through all cosmic cycles

names.name: परर्द्धिः
names.meaning: He of supreme prosperity; the one who possesses the highest and most exalted divine wealth

names.name: परमस्पष्टः
names.meaning: He who is supremely clear; the most evident and self-manifest reality, needing no proof

names.name: तुष्टः
names.meaning: The ever-contented one; He who is eternally satisfied, being complete in Himself

names.name: पुष्टः
names.meaning: The well-nourished one; He who is full and complete, lacking nothing whatsoever

names.name: शुभेक्षणः
names.meaning: He whose glance is auspicious; the Lord whose very gaze bestows blessings and well-being

verses.sanskritDevanagari:
रामो विरामो विरजो मार्गो नेयो नयोऽनयः ।
वीरः शक्तिमतां श्रेष्ठो धर्मो धर्मविदुत्तमः ॥ ४३॥
verses.transliteration:
rāmo virāmo virajo mārgo neyo nayo'nayaḥ |
vīraḥ śaktimatāṃ śreṣṭho dharmo dharmaviduttamaḥ || 43 ||

names.name: रामः
names.meaning: He who delights all; the one in whom yogis rejoice, and who incarnated as the ideal king Rama

names.name: विरामः
names.meaning: The final rest; He in whom all beings find their ultimate cessation and supreme repose

names.name: विरजः
names.meaning: The passionless one; He who is free from rajas and all impurities of the material world

names.name: मार्गः
names.meaning: The path to liberation; He who is the way sought by seekers of truth and ultimate freedom

names.name: नेयः
names.meaning: He who guides; the leader who directs beings along the righteous path toward the supreme goal

names.name: नयः
names.meaning: He who is divine wisdom; the embodiment of right conduct and supreme moral guidance

names.name: अनयः
names.meaning: He who has no master; the one whom no higher authority leads, being the supreme leader Himself

names.name: वीरः
names.meaning: The courageous hero; He who is supremely valiant and possesses infinite strength and power

names.name: शक्तिमतां श्रेष्ठः
names.meaning: The foremost among the powerful; He who is the greatest of all who possess divine strength

names.name: धर्मः
names.meaning: Dharma personified; He who is the eternal cosmic law and the very essence of righteousness

names.name: धर्मविदुत्तमः
names.meaning: The supreme among the knowers of dharma; the highest authority on righteousness and sacred law

verses.sanskritDevanagari:
वैकुण्ठः पुरुषः प्राणः प्राणदः प्रणवः पृथुः ।
हिरण्यगर्भः शत्रुघ्नो व्यासो वायुरोधक्षजः ॥ ४४॥
verses.transliteration:
vaikuṇṭhaḥ puruṣaḥ prāṇaḥ prāṇadaḥ praṇavaḥ pṛthuḥ |
hiraṇyagarbhaḥ śatrughno vyāso vāyurodhakṣajaḥ || 44 ||

names.name: वैकुण्ठः
names.meaning: The Lord of Vaikuntha; He who unites all beings and whose abode is the supreme spiritual realm

names.name: पुरुषः
names.meaning: The supreme cosmic Person; He who pervades and fills the entire universe with His presence

names.name: प्राणः
names.meaning: The supreme life-force; the vital breath that is the essence of all living existence

names.name: प्राणदः
names.meaning: The giver of life; He who bestows the vital breath upon all creatures and sustains them

names.name: प्रणवः
names.meaning: He who is Om; the sacred syllable that is the essence of all Vedas and the symbol of Brahman

names.name: पृथुः
names.meaning: The vast and expansive one; He who incarnated as king Prithu to nurture the earth and its beings

names.name: हिरण्यगर्भः
names.meaning: The golden-wombed one; He who contains the entire universe within Himself like a golden embryo

names.name: शत्रुघ्नः
names.meaning: The slayer of enemies; He who destroys the inner foes of desire, anger, and ignorance

names.name: व्यासः
names.meaning: The compiler and arranger; He who divided the Vedas and composed the Mahabharata as sage Vyasa

names.name: वायुरोधक्षजः
names.meaning: He who is born as the controller of Vayu; or the one from whom Vayu and Rudra originate

verses.sanskritDevanagari:
ऋतुः सुदर्शनः कालः परमेष्ठी परिग्रहः ।
उग्रः संवत्सरो दक्षो विश्रामो विश्वदक्षिणः ॥ ४५॥
verses.transliteration:
ṛtuḥ sudarśanaḥ kālaḥ parameṣṭhī parigrahaḥ |
ugraḥ saṃvatsaro dakṣo viśrāmo viśvadakṣiṇaḥ || 45 ||

names.name: ऋतुः
names.meaning: He who is the seasons; the Lord who manifests as the rhythmic cycles of time in nature

names.name: सुदर्शनः
names.meaning: He who is beautiful to behold; the possessor of the divine discus Sudarshana that destroys evil

names.name: कालः
names.meaning: He who is Time; the all-consuming force that measures out the destiny of every being

names.name: परमेष्ठी
names.meaning: He who resides in the highest abode; the supreme one established in the most exalted state

names.name: परिग्रहः
names.meaning: He who receives all offerings; the Lord who accepts and is accessible from every direction

names.name: उग्रः
names.meaning: The fierce one; He who is terrifying to the wicked and those who violate dharma

names.name: संवत्सरः
names.meaning: He who is the year; the Lord who embodies the fullness of time and its cyclical nature

names.name: दक्षः
names.meaning: The skillful and capable one; He who performs all actions with supreme competence and swiftness

names.name: विश्रामः
names.meaning: The place of rest; He in whom all weary beings find their ultimate repose and peace

names.name: विश्वदक्षिणः
names.meaning: He who is generous to the entire universe; the most skilled one who is proficient in all things

verses.sanskritDevanagari:
विस्तारः स्थावरस्थाणुः प्रमाणं बीजमव्ययम् ।
अर्थोऽनर्थो महाकोशो महाभोगो महाधनः ॥ ४६॥
verses.transliteration:
vistāraḥ sthāvarasthāṇuḥ pramāṇaṃ bījamavyayam |
artho'nartho mahākośo mahābhogo mahādhanaḥ || 46 ||

names.name: विस्तारः
names.meaning: He who is vast expansion; the one who manifests as the boundless expanse of the entire creation

names.name: स्थावरस्थाणुः
names.meaning: He who is the firm pillar among the immovable; the eternal, unchanging support of all that is fixed

names.name: प्रमाणम्
names.meaning: The standard of proof; He who is the ultimate authority and measure of all knowledge and truth

names.name: बीजमव्ययम्
names.meaning: The imperishable seed; the eternal cause from which the entire universe sprouts without ever being exhausted

names.name: अर्थः
names.meaning: The goal; He who is the supreme purpose sought by all beings and the meaning of all existence

names.name: अनर्थः
names.meaning: He who is without want; the self-sufficient one who has no unfulfilled purpose or need

names.name: महाकोशः
names.meaning: The great treasure; He who is the vast repository of all cosmic wealth and spiritual riches

names.name: महाभोगः
names.meaning: He of great enjoyment; the Lord who possesses supreme bliss and infinite divine experiences

names.name: महाधनः
names.meaning: He of immense wealth; the possessor of the greatest treasures, both material and spiritual

verses.sanskritDevanagari:
अनिर्विण्णः स्थविष्ठोऽभूर्धर्मयूपो महामखः ।
नक्षत्रनेमिर्नक्षत्री क्षमः क्षामः समीहनः ॥ ४७॥
verses.transliteration:
anirviṇṇaḥ sthaviṣṭho'bhūrdharmayūpo mahāmakhaḥ |
nakṣatranemirnak ṣatrī kṣamaḥ kṣāmaḥ samīhanaḥ || 47 ||

names.name: अनिर्विण्णः
names.meaning: He who is never despondent; the Lord who is eternally enthusiastic and free from all weariness

names.name: स्थविष्ठः
names.meaning: The most massive; He who is supremely vast, the greatest in magnitude among all beings

names.name: अभूः
names.meaning: He who is without birth; the unborn reality who transcends the cycle of birth and existence

names.name: धर्मयूपः
names.meaning: The sacrificial post of dharma; He to whom all righteous actions are bound and dedicated

names.name: महामखः
names.meaning: The great sacrifice; He who is the supreme yajna from which all creation emerges

names.name: नक्षत्रनेमिः
names.meaning: The hub of the stellar wheel; He who is the axis around which all the constellations revolve

names.name: नक्षत्री
names.meaning: The Lord of the stars; He who is the moon that nourishes and governs all the nakshatras

names.name: क्षमः
names.meaning: The patient and capable one; He who endures all with supreme forbearance and competence

names.name: क्षामः
names.meaning: He who reduces and diminishes; the Lord who wanes all that is impure and unrighteous

names.name: समीहनः
names.meaning: He who strives well; the Lord whose divine efforts perfectly accomplish the welfare of all beings

verses.sanskritDevanagari:
यज्ञ इज्यो महेज्यश्च क्रतुः सत्रं सतां गतिः ।
सर्वदर्शी विमुक्तात्मा सर्वज्ञो ज्ञानमुत्तमम् ॥ ४८॥
verses.transliteration:
yajña ijyo mahejyaśca kratuḥ satraṃ satāṃ gatiḥ |
sarvadarśī vimuktātmā sarvajño jñānamuttamam || 48 ||

names.name: यज्ञः
names.meaning: He who is the sacrifice itself; the Lord who is both the act of worship and its ultimate recipient

names.name: इज्यः
names.meaning: He who is worthy of worship; the supreme deity deserving of all Vedic sacrificial offerings

names.name: महेज्यः
names.meaning: He who is the most worshipful; the greatest object of veneration surpassing all other deities

names.name: क्रतुः
names.meaning: He who is the Vedic ritual; the Lord who manifests as the will and resolve behind every sacred rite

names.name: सत्रम्
names.meaning: He who is the extended sacrifice; the Lord who protects the virtuous through the cosmic yajna

names.name: सतां गतिः
names.meaning: The refuge of the virtuous; He who is the final destination and supreme shelter of all righteous souls

names.name: सर्वदर्शी
names.meaning: The all-seeing one; He who perceives everything in the universe with His omniscient vision

names.name: विमुक्तात्मा
names.meaning: He whose Self is ever free; the eternally liberated one who is never bound by maya or karma

names.name: सर्वज्ञः
names.meaning: The omniscient one; He who knows everything — past, present, and future — simultaneously

names.name: ज्ञानमुत्तमम्
names.meaning: The supreme knowledge itself; He who is the highest wisdom that leads to ultimate liberation

verses.sanskritDevanagari:
सुव्रतः सुमुखः सूक्ष्मः सुघोषः सुखदः सुहृत् ।
मनोहरो जितक्रोधो वीरबाहुर्विदारणः ॥ ४९॥
verses.transliteration:
suvrataḥ sumukhaḥ sūkṣmaḥ sughoṣaḥ sukhadaḥ suhṛt |
manoharo jitakrodho vīrabāhurvidāraṇaḥ || 49 ||

names.name: सुव्रतः
names.meaning: He of noble vows; the Lord whose divine resolve is always auspicious and never fails

names.name: सुमुखः
names.meaning: He of the beautiful face; the Lord whose countenance radiates grace, charm, and divine delight

names.name: सूक्ष्मः
names.meaning: The subtle one; He who is finer than the finest atom and beyond the grasp of the senses

names.name: सुघोषः
names.meaning: He of the auspicious voice; the Lord whose divine sound as the Vedas pervades all creation

names.name: सुखदः
names.meaning: The giver of happiness; He who bestows the highest bliss of moksha upon His devotees

names.name: सुहृत्
names.meaning: The true friend; He who is the selfless well-wisher of all beings without expecting anything in return

names.name: मनोहरः
names.meaning: The captivator of minds; He whose beauty and charm steal the hearts of all who behold Him

names.name: जितक्रोधः
names.meaning: He who has conquered anger; the Lord who has fully mastered wrath and all destructive emotions

names.name: वीरबाहुः
names.meaning: He of heroic arms; the Lord whose mighty arms protect the righteous and vanquish evil

names.name: विदारणः
names.meaning: The splitter asunder; He who tears apart the forces of evil and the bonds of ignorance

verses.sanskritDevanagari:
स्वापनः स्ववशो व्यापी नैकात्मा नैककर्मकृत् ।
वत्सरो वत्सलो वत्सी रत्नगर्भो धनेश्वरः ॥ ५०॥
verses.transliteration:
svāpanaḥ svavaśo vyāpī naikātmā naikakarmakṛt |
vatsaro vatsalo vatsī ratnagarbho dhaneśvaraḥ || 50 ||

names.name: स्वापनः
names.meaning: He who lulls beings to sleep; the Lord who draws all creatures into the cosmic slumber of dissolution

names.name: स्ववशः
names.meaning: He who is self-governed; the Lord who is completely independent and subject only to His own will

names.name: व्यापी
names.meaning: The all-pervading one; He who permeates every particle and every corner of the universe

names.name: नैकात्मा
names.meaning: He of many forms; the Lord who manifests as the inner Self in countless diverse beings

names.name: नैककर्मकृत्
names.meaning: He who performs manifold actions; the Lord who simultaneously carries out countless cosmic deeds

names.name: वत्सरः
names.meaning: He in whom all beings abide; the Lord who is the dwelling place of the entire universe

names.name: वत्सलः
names.meaning: The affectionate one; He who overflows with tender love toward His devotees like a parent to a child

names.name: वत्सी
names.meaning: He who protects His children; the loving father who nurtures and cares for all beings as His own

names.name: रत्नगर्भः
names.meaning: He who is the womb of gems; the cosmic ocean from whose depths all precious treasures originate

names.name: धनेश्वरः
names.meaning: The Lord of wealth; the supreme master of all riches who bestows prosperity upon the deserving

verses.sanskritDevanagari:
धर्मगुब्धर्मकृद्धर्मी सदसत्क्षरमक्षरम् ।
अविज्ञाता सहस्रांशुर्विधाता कृतलक्षणः ॥ ५१॥
verses.transliteration:
dharmagubdharmakṛddharmī sadasatkṣaramakṣaram |
avijñātā sahasrāṃśurvidhātā kṛtalakṣaṇaḥ || 51 ||

names.name: धर्मगुप्
names.meaning: The protector of dharma; He who safeguards righteousness and preserves the moral order of the universe

names.name: धर्मकृत्
names.meaning: The establisher of dharma; He who enacts and upholds the laws of righteousness in creation

names.name: धर्मी
names.meaning: The embodiment of dharma; He who is always established in and identified with righteousness

names.name: सत्
names.meaning: That which truly exists; the absolute reality, the eternal Being that underlies all phenomena

names.name: असत्क्षरम्
names.meaning: The perishable manifest world; He who is the changing phenomenal universe perceived by the senses

names.name: अक्षरम्
names.meaning: The imperishable; the changeless eternal reality beyond all modification and decay

names.name: अविज्ञाता
names.meaning: He who cannot be fully known; the Lord whose infinite nature transcends all finite comprehension

names.name: सहस्रांशुः
names.meaning: He of a thousand rays; the Lord whose brilliance radiates in infinite beams like the supreme sun

names.name: विधाता
names.meaning: The supreme ordainer; He who dispenses the fruits of karma and arranges the destiny of all beings

names.name: कृतलक्षणः
names.meaning: He who is known by definite marks; the Lord who has established the sacred scriptures as His signs

verses.sanskritDevanagari:
गभस्तिनेमिः सत्त्वस्थः सिंहो भूतमहेश्वरः ।
आदिदेवो महादेवो देवेशो देवभृद्गुरुः ॥ ५२॥
verses.transliteration:
gabhastinemiḥ sattvasthah siṃho bhūtamaheśvaraḥ |
ādidevo mahādevo deveśo devabhṛdguruḥ || 52 ||

names.name: गभस्तिनेमिः
names.meaning: He who is the hub of the cosmic wheel of light; the central axis from which all radiance emanates

names.name: सत्त्वस्थः
names.meaning: He who abides in sattva; the Lord who is established in pure goodness and truth

names.name: सिंहः
names.meaning: The lion; He who is supremely powerful and courageous, as in His Narasimha incarnation

names.name: भूतमहेश्वरः
names.meaning: The great Lord of all beings; the supreme sovereign who rules over every creature in existence

names.name: आदिदेवः
names.meaning: The first deity; the primordial god who existed before all other divine beings came into existence

names.name: महादेवः
names.meaning: The great god; the supreme deity who is the greatest among all gods and beyond all comparison

names.name: देवेशः
names.meaning: The Lord of all gods; the divine ruler whom all the devas worship and serve with devotion

names.name: देवभृद्गुरुः
names.meaning: The sustainer and teacher of the gods; the supreme preceptor who guides and supports all devas

verses.sanskritDevanagari:
उत्तरो गोपतिर्गोप्ता ज्ञानगम्यः पुरातनः ।
शरीरभूतभृद्भोक्ता कपीन्द्रो भूरिदक्षिणः ॥ ५३॥
verses.transliteration:
uttaro gopatirgoptā jñānagamyaḥ purātanaḥ |
śarīrabhūtabhṛdbhoktā kapīndro bhūridakṣiṇaḥ || 53 ||

names.name: उत्तरः
names.meaning: The superior one; He who transcends all beings by the excellence of His nature, knowledge, and power

names.name: गोपतिः
names.meaning: The Lord of the earth and of speech; the protector of all cattle, the Vedas, and the world

names.name: गोप्ता
names.meaning: The protector; He who guards and shelters all beings as a cowherd protects his flock

names.name: ज्ञानगम्यः
names.meaning: He who is attainable through knowledge alone; the supreme reality accessible only through jnana

names.name: पुरातनः
names.meaning: The most ancient one; He who existed before all of creation and is the primordial being

names.name: शरीरभूतभृत्
