names.meaning: The sustainer of the elements that constitute the body; He who supports the five great elements forming all physical forms

names.name: भोक्ता
names.meaning: The enjoyer; He who experiences the bliss of His own infinite nature and who is the ultimate experiencer in all beings

names.name: कपीन्द्रः
names.meaning: The Lord of the monkeys; He who as Rama commanded Hanuman and the vanara hosts, or the supreme among sages

names.name: भूरिदक्षिणः
names.meaning: He who gives abundantly; the supremely generous one who bestows lavish rewards upon His devotees

verses.sanskritDevanagari:
सोमपोऽमृतपः सोमः पुरुजित्पुरुसत्तमः ।
विनयो जयः सत्यसन्धो दाशार्हः सात्वताम्पतिः ॥ ५४॥
verses.transliteration:
somapo'mṛtapaḥ somaḥ purujitpurusattamaḥ |
vinayo jayaḥ satyasandho dāśārhaḥ sātvatāmpatiḥ || 54 ||

names.name: सोमपः
names.meaning: He who drinks the Soma; the Lord who receives the soma oblations offered in Vedic sacrifices

names.name: अमृतपः
names.meaning: He who drinks the nectar of immortality; the one who partakes of the bliss of His own eternal nature

names.name: सोमः
names.meaning: He who is the moon; the nourisher of all plants and beings through the cooling nectar of His grace

names.name: पुरुजित्
names.meaning: The conqueror of many; He who has vanquished numerous enemies and demons in His divine incarnations

names.name: पुरुसत्तमः
names.meaning: The best among beings; the most excellent of all purushas, supreme in virtue and greatness

names.name: विनयः
names.meaning: He who embodies humility; the one who disciplines the wicked and guides the righteous with gentle grace

names.name: जयः
names.meaning: He who is victory itself; the one who always triumphs and from whom all conquest originates

names.name: सत्यसन्धः
names.meaning: He whose resolve is always true; the one whose vows and promises are unfailingly fulfilled

names.name: दाशार्हः
names.meaning: He who was born in the Dasharha clan; a descendant of the illustrious Yadu dynasty as Lord Krishna

names.name: सात्वतांपतिः
names.meaning: The Lord of the Satvatas; the master and protector of the Yadava devotees who follow the path of devotion

verses.sanskritDevanagari:
जीवो विनयिता साक्षी मुकुन्दोऽमितविक्रमः ।
अम्भोनिधिरनन्तात्मा महोदधिशयोऽन्तकः ॥ ५५॥
verses.transliteration:
jīvo vinayitā sākṣī mukundo'mitavikramaḥ |
ambhonidhiranantātmā mahodadhiśayo'ntakaḥ || 55 ||

names.name: जीवः
names.meaning: The life principle; He who as the inner Self animates all living beings with the breath of life

names.name: विनयिता
names.meaning: The great discipliner; He who humbles the proud and subdues those who stray from the path of dharma

names.name: साक्षी
names.meaning: The eternal witness; He who directly perceives all events in all beings without being affected or altered

names.name: मुकुन्दः
names.meaning: The bestower of liberation; He who grants mukti (freedom from the cycle of birth and death) to His devotees

names.name: अमितविक्रमः
names.meaning: He of immeasurable valor; the one whose prowess and heroic strides are boundless, as shown in the Vamana avatara

names.name: अम्भोनिधिः
names.meaning: The ocean; He who is the vast reservoir of all waters and the abode of infinite depth and mystery

names.name: अनन्तात्मा
names.meaning: He whose Self is infinite; the one whose nature is without limit in space, time, or attribute

names.name: महोदधिशयः
names.meaning: He who reclines upon the great ocean; the Lord who rests on the cosmic waters as Narayana on Adishesha

names.name: अन्तकः
names.meaning: He who brings about the end; the destroyer who dissolves all beings at the time of cosmic dissolution

verses.sanskritDevanagari:
अजो महार्हः स्वाभाव्यो जितामित्रः प्रमोदनः ।
आनन्दो नन्दनो नन्दः सत्यधर्मा त्रिविक्रमः ॥ ५६॥
verses.transliteration:
ajo mahārhaḥ svābhāvyo jitāmitraḥ pramodanaḥ |
ānando nandano nandaḥ satyadharmā trivikramaḥ || 56 ||

names.name: अजः
names.meaning: The unborn; He who has no origin and is never subject to birth, being the eternal uncaused cause

names.name: महार्हः
names.meaning: He who is worthy of the highest worship; the most deserving recipient of all devotional offerings

names.name: स्वाभाव्यः
names.meaning: He who is eternally established in His own nature; the one whose greatness is inherent and self-existing

names.name: जितामित्रः
names.meaning: He who has conquered all enemies; the invincible Lord who subdues both internal and external foes

names.name: प्रमोदनः
names.meaning: He who is always full of delight; the one who fills His devotees with supreme joy and celebration

names.name: आनन्दः
names.meaning: He who is bliss itself; the supreme reality whose essential nature is pure, unconditioned happiness

names.name: नन्दनः
names.meaning: He who brings joy to others; the one who delights all beings and fills them with happiness

names.name: नन्दः
names.meaning: He who is endowed with all joyful perfections; the one who is free from all worldly desires and full of bliss

names.name: सत्यधर्मा
names.meaning: He whose dharma is truth; the one who embodies and upholds truth as the highest righteous principle

names.name: त्रिविक्रमः
names.meaning: He who covered the three worlds in three strides; the Vamana incarnation who measured earth, sky, and heaven

verses.sanskritDevanagari:
महर्षिः कपिलाचार्यः कृतज्ञो मेदिनीपतिः ।
त्रिपदस्त्रिदशाध्यक्षो महाशृङ्गः कृतान्तकृत् ॥ ५७॥
verses.transliteration:
maharṣiḥ kapilācāryaḥ kṛtajño medinīpatiḥ |
tripadastridaśādhyakṣo mahāśṛṅgaḥ kṛtāntakṛt || 57 ||

names.name: महर्षिः
names.meaning: The great sage; He who is the supreme rishi and the source of all sacred knowledge and revelation

names.name: कपिलाचार्यः
names.meaning: The teacher Kapila; He who incarnated as the sage Kapila, the founder of the Sankhya philosophy

names.name: कृतज्ञः
names.meaning: He who knows all that has been done; the grateful Lord who remembers even the smallest offering of His devotees

names.name: मेदिनीपतिः
names.meaning: The Lord of the earth; the sovereign protector and ruler of the entire terrestrial world

names.name: त्रिपदः
names.meaning: He who has three strides; the Vamana who encompassed the three realms, or He who is reached by three steps of knowledge

names.name: त्रिदशाध्यक्षः
names.meaning: The overlord of the thirty-three devas; the supreme presiding deity of all celestial beings

names.name: महाशृङ्गः
names.meaning: He with the great horn; the Matsya avatara who bore a magnificent horn, or the supreme cosmic peak

names.name: कृतान्तकृत्
names.meaning: He who destroys even death; the Lord who puts an end to Yama's power and overcomes the finality of death itself

verses.sanskritDevanagari:
महावराहो गोविन्दः सुषेणः कनकाङ्गदी ।
गुह्यो गभीरो गहनो गुप्तश्चक्रगदाधरः ॥ ५८॥
verses.transliteration:
mahāvarāho govindaḥ suṣeṇaḥ kanakāṅgadī |
guhyo gabhīro gahano guptaścakragadādharaḥ || 58 ||

names.name: महावराहः
names.meaning: The great boar; He who assumed the colossal Varaha form to rescue the earth from the cosmic ocean

names.name: गोविन्दः
names.meaning: The finder of the cows and the Vedas; He who recovered the earth and is known through Vedic speech

names.name: सुषेणः
names.meaning: He who has a splendid army; the Lord whose divine hosts and celestial forces are glorious and invincible

names.name: कनकाङ्गदी
names.meaning: He who wears golden armlets; the resplendent Lord adorned with brilliant gold ornaments on His arms

names.name: गुह्यः
names.meaning: The mysterious one; He who is hidden in the cave of the heart and is the most secret of all truths

names.name: गभीरः
names.meaning: The unfathomable; He whose nature, power, and wisdom are of immeasurable depth

names.name: गहनः
names.meaning: The impenetrable; He who is difficult to comprehend, like a dense and trackless forest of mystery

names.name: गुप्तः
names.meaning: The hidden one; He who is concealed by His own maya and is not perceivable by ordinary senses

names.name: चक्रगदाधरः
names.meaning: He who bears the discus and the mace; the Lord who wields the Sudarshana Chakra and the Kaumodaki Gada

verses.sanskritDevanagari:
वेधाः स्वाङ्गोऽजितः कृष्णो दृढः सङ्कर्षणोऽच्युतः ।
वरुणो वारुणो वृक्षः पुष्कराक्षो महामनाः ॥ ५९॥
verses.transliteration:
vedhāḥ svāṅgo'jitaḥ kṛṣṇo dṛḍhaḥ saṅkarṣaṇo'cyutaḥ |
varuṇo vāruṇo vṛkṣaḥ puṣkarākṣo mahāmanāḥ || 59 ||

names.name: वेधाः
names.meaning: The creator; He who brings forth the universe and ordains the destinies of all beings through His cosmic will

names.name: स्वाङ्गः
names.meaning: He whose limbs are beautiful by their own nature; the self-sufficient Lord who needs no external adornment

names.name: अजितः
names.meaning: The unconquered; He who has never been defeated by anyone and remains eternally invincible

names.name: कृष्णः
names.meaning: The dark-complexioned one; He who is the all-attractive supreme being, drawing all souls to Himself

names.name: दृढः
names.meaning: The firm and steadfast; He whose nature, resolve, and existence are absolutely unshakeable

names.name: सङ्कर्षणः
names.meaning: He who draws all beings together at the time of dissolution; the Balarama form who attracts all souls

names.name: अच्युतः
names.meaning: He who never falls from His glory; the infallible one who never declines from His supreme state

names.name: वरुणः
names.meaning: He who envelops and covers; the deity of the cosmic waters who conceals all within Himself

names.name: वारुणः
names.meaning: The son of Varuna; He who is associated with the lord of the waters, or the sage Vasishtha born of Varuna

names.name: वृक्षः
names.meaning: The tree of the world; He who is the eternal Ashvattha tree of samsara rooted in Brahman

names.name: पुष्कराक्षः
names.meaning: The lotus-eyed one; He whose beautiful eyes resemble lotus petals radiating compassion and grace

names.name: महामनाः
names.meaning: The great-minded one; He whose mind encompasses all of creation with infinite knowledge and compassion

verses.sanskritDevanagari:
भगवान् भगहाऽऽनन्दी वनमाली हलायुधः ।
आदित्यो ज्योतिरादित्यः सहिष्णुर्गतिसत्तमः ॥ ६०॥
verses.transliteration:
bhagavān bhagahā''nandī vanamālī halāyudhaḥ |
ādityo jyotirādityaḥ sahiṣṇurgatisattamaḥ || 60 ||

names.name: भगवान्
names.meaning: The possessor of all six divine attributes: lordship, righteousness, glory, wealth, knowledge, and detachment

names.name: भगहा
names.meaning: The destroyer of fortune of the unrighteous; He who removes the worldly attachments of those He liberates

names.name: आनन्दी
names.meaning: He who is full of bliss; the Lord who eternally revels in the joy of His own supreme nature

names.name: वनमाली
names.meaning: He who wears the Vaijayanti garland of forest flowers; the Lord adorned with the fragrant wildflower wreath

names.name: हलायुधः
names.meaning: He who wields the plough as His weapon; Balarama who bears the divine plough Hala in His hand

names.name: आदित्यः
names.meaning: The son of Aditi; He who manifests as the supreme solar deity, the golden brilliance within the sun

names.name: ज्योतिरादित्यः
names.meaning: The radiance within the sun; He who is the luminous splendor that illumines the sun itself

names.name: सहिष्णुः
names.meaning: The supremely patient one; He who endures all opposites with infinite forbearance and equanimity

names.name: गतिसत्तमः
names.meaning: The greatest refuge; He who is the supreme destination and the most excellent goal of all beings

verses.sanskritDevanagari:
सुधन्वा खण्डपरशुर्दारुणो द्रविणप्रदः ।
दिवस्पृक् सर्वदृग्व्यासो वाचस्पतिरयोनिजः ॥ ६१॥
verses.transliteration:
sudhanvā khaṇḍaparaśurdāruṇo draviṇapradaḥ |
divaspṛk sarvadṛgvyāso vācaspatirayonijaḥ || 61 ||

names.name: सुधन्वा
names.meaning: He who possesses a magnificent bow; the Lord whose divine bow Sharnga is supremely beautiful and powerful

names.name: खण्डपरशुः
names.meaning: He who wields the broken axe; or He who shatters with His axe, as Parashurama who destroyed the kshatriyas

names.name: दारुणः
names.meaning: The terrifying one; He who is merciless toward the wicked and strikes fear into the hearts of the unrighteous

names.name: द्रविणप्रदः
names.meaning: The bestower of wealth; He who generously grants material prosperity and spiritual riches to His devotees

names.name: दिवस्पृक्
names.meaning: He who touches the sky; the Lord whose glory reaches the highest heavens and pervades the celestial realms

names.name: सर्वदृग्व्यासः
names.meaning: The all-seeing Vyasa; He who, as sage Vyasa, perceived all truths and classified the Vedas for humanity

names.name: वाचस्पतिः
names.meaning: The Lord of speech; He who is the master of all eloquence and the presiding deity of sacred utterance

names.name: अयोनिजः
names.meaning: He who is not born from a womb; the Lord who manifests without any material origin or physical birth

verses.sanskritDevanagari:
त्रिसामा सामगः साम निर्वाणं भेषजं भिषक् ।
संन्यासकृच्छमः शान्तो निष्ठा शान्तिः परायणम् ॥ ६२॥
verses.transliteration:
trisāmā sāmagaḥ sāma nirvāṇaṃ bheṣajaṃ bhiṣak |
saṃnyāsakṛcchamaḥ śānto niṣṭhā śāntiḥ parāyaṇam || 62 ||

names.name: त्रिसामा
names.meaning: He who is praised by the three Sama hymns — Devavrata, Rathantara, and Brihat — the essence of Sama Veda

names.name: सामगः
names.meaning: The singer of the Sama Veda; He who is the melodious chant of the sacred hymns and their ultimate meaning

names.name: साम
names.meaning: He who is the Sama Veda itself; the Lord who is the essence of divine music and Vedic harmony

names.name: निर्वाणम्
names.meaning: He who is supreme bliss and liberation; the ultimate state of extinction of all suffering and ignorance

names.name: भेषजम्
names.meaning: The divine medicine; He who is the supreme remedy that cures the disease of worldly existence (samsara)

names.name: भिषक्
names.meaning: The divine physician; He who heals the afflictions of birth and death and treats the ailment of ignorance

names.name: संन्यासकृत्
names.meaning: The establisher of renunciation; He who instituted the sacred order of sannyasa for the liberation of souls

names.name: शमः
names.meaning: He who is tranquility itself; the supreme peace and inner calm that transcends all mental agitation

names.name: शान्तः
names.meaning: The peaceful one; He who is completely serene, having subdued all passions and disturbances

names.name: निष्ठा
names.meaning: The ultimate abode; He in whom all beings finally rest and find their supreme fulfillment

names.name: शान्तिः
names.meaning: He who is peace itself; the supreme tranquility that is the final goal of all spiritual seeking

names.name: परायणम्
names.meaning: The supreme goal; the highest refuge and ultimate destination to which all spiritual paths lead

verses.sanskritDevanagari:
शुभाङ्गः शान्तिदः स्रष्टा कुमुदः कुवलेशयः ।
गोहितो गोपतिर्गोप्ता वृषभाक्षो वृषप्रियः ॥ ६३॥
verses.transliteration:
śubhāṅgaḥ śāntidaḥ sraṣṭā kumudaḥ kuvalēśayaḥ |
gohito gopatirgoptā vṛṣabhākṣo vṛṣapriyaḥ || 63 ||

names.name: शुभाङ्गः
names.meaning: He of auspicious limbs; the Lord whose every part is divinely beautiful and radiates sacred grace

names.name: शान्तिदः
names.meaning: The bestower of peace; He who grants supreme tranquility and inner stillness to His devotees

names.name: स्रष्टा
names.meaning: The creator; He who projects the entire universe from Himself at the beginning of each cosmic cycle

names.name: कुमुदः
names.meaning: He who delights the earth; the Lord who brings joy to the world, like the kumuda (white water lily) that blossoms in moonlight

names.name: कुवलेशयः
names.meaning: He who reclines on the waters; the Lord who rests upon the cosmic ocean, or He who dwells in the lotus of the heart

names.name: गोहितः
names.meaning: He who acts for the welfare of the earth and cows; the benefactor of speech, knowledge, and all living beings

names.name: गोपतिः
names.meaning: The Lord of the earth; the master and protector of all cattle, speech, and living creatures

names.name: गोप्ता
names.meaning: The protector; He who shields and safeguards the entire creation from harm and destruction

names.name: वृषभाक्षः
names.meaning: He whose eyes shower blessings of dharma; the Lord whose gracious glance bestows righteousness upon all

names.name: वृषप्रियः
names.meaning: He who delights in dharma; the Lord who loves righteousness and is pleased by virtuous conduct

verses.sanskritDevanagari:
अनिवर्ती निवृत्तात्मा सङ्क्षेप्ता क्षेमकृच्छिवः ।
श्रीवत्सवक्षाः श्रीवासः श्रीपतिः श्रीमतांवरः ॥ ६४॥
verses.transliteration:
anivartī nivṛttātmā saṅkṣeptā kṣemakṛcchivaḥ |
śrīvatsavakṣāḥ śrīvāsaḥ śrīpatiḥ śrīmatāṃvaraḥ || 64 ||

names.name: अनिवर्ती
names.meaning: He who never retreats; the Lord who never turns back from battle, truth, or the protection of His devotees

names.name: निवृत्तात्मा
names.meaning: He whose Self is turned away from worldly existence; the Lord who is completely free from material attachments

names.name: सङ्क्षेप्ता
names.meaning: He who contracts and withdraws; the Lord who draws the entire creation back into Himself at dissolution

names.name: क्षेमकृत्
names.meaning: He who creates well-being; the Lord who ensures the safety, security, and welfare of all beings

names.name: शिवः
names.meaning: The auspicious and pure one; He who bestows supreme blessedness and is intrinsically good and holy

names.name: श्रीवत्सवक्षाः
names.meaning: He who bears the Srivatsa mark on His chest; the Lord on whose breast resides the sacred curl symbolizing Lakshmi

names.name: श्रीवासः
names.meaning: He in whom Shri (Lakshmi) eternally dwells; the permanent abode of all divine prosperity and grace

names.name: श्रीपतिः
names.meaning: The Lord of Shri (Lakshmi); the divine consort and master of the goddess of fortune and auspiciousness

names.name: श्रीमतांवरः
names.meaning: The best among the glorious; the most excellent of all who possess divine splendor and prosperity

verses.sanskritDevanagari:
श्रीदः श्रीशः श्रीनिवासः श्रीनिधिः श्रीविभावनः ।
श्रीधरः श्रीकरः श्रेयः श्रीमाँल्लोकत्रयाश्रयः ॥ ६५॥
verses.transliteration:
śrīdaḥ śrīśaḥ śrīnivāsaḥ śrīnidhiḥ śrīvibhāvanaḥ |
śrīdharaḥ śrīkaraḥ śreyaḥ śrīmāṃllōkatrayāśrayaḥ || 65 ||

names.name: श्रीदः
names.meaning: The giver of Shri; He who bestows wealth, beauty, and auspiciousness upon His devotees

names.name: श्रीशः
names.meaning: The Lord of Shri; He who is the supreme master and controller of all divine prosperity

names.name: श्रीनिवासः
names.meaning: He in whom Shri resides; the eternal dwelling place of Lakshmi and all auspiciousness

names.name: श्रीनिधिः
names.meaning: The treasure of Shri; He who is the inexhaustible storehouse of all divine wealth and glory

names.name: श्रीविभावनः
names.meaning: He who manifests Shri everywhere; the Lord who creates and distributes divine prosperity throughout creation

names.name: श्रीधरः
names.meaning: The bearer of Shri; He who carries Lakshmi upon His chest and upholds all that is sacred and beautiful

names.name: श्रीकरः
names.meaning: He who makes everything auspicious; the Lord whose very touch or glance confers divine grace and prosperity

names.name: श्रेयः
names.meaning: The supreme good; He who is the highest spiritual welfare and the ultimate benefit for all beings

names.name: श्रीमान्
names.meaning: He who is ever endowed with Shri; the Lord who eternally possesses all divine splendor, beauty, and majesty

names.name: लोकत्रयाश्रयः
names.meaning: The refuge of the three worlds; He who is the support and shelter of the celestial, terrestrial, and nether realms

verses.sanskritDevanagari:
स्वक्षः स्वङ्गः शतानन्दो नन्दिर्ज्योतिर्गणेश्वरः ।
विजितात्माऽविधेयात्मा सत्कीर्तिश्छिन्नसंशयः ॥ ६६॥
verses.transliteration:
svakṣaḥ svaṅgaḥ śatānando nandirjyotirgaṇeśvaraḥ |
vijitātmā'vidheyātmā satkīrtiśchinnasaṃśayaḥ || 66 ||

names.name: स्वक्षः
names.meaning: He who has beautiful eyes; the Lord whose divine eyes see everything with perfect clarity and grace

names.name: स्वङ्गः
names.meaning: He who has beautiful limbs; the Lord whose divine form is supremely graceful and perfectly proportioned

names.name: शतानन्दः
names.meaning: He of hundredfold bliss; the Lord who possesses infinite varieties and degrees of supreme joy

names.name: नन्दिः
names.meaning: He who is blissful; the Lord who is the embodiment of divine happiness and causes joy in others

names.name: ज्योतिर्गणेश्वरः
names.meaning: The lord of the hosts of luminaries; He who commands the sun, moon, stars, and all celestial lights

names.name: विजितात्मा
names.meaning: He who has completely conquered the Self; the Lord who has perfect mastery over His own divine nature

names.name: अविधेयात्मा
names.meaning: He who cannot be controlled by anyone; the Lord whose Self is independent and subject to no external authority

names.name: सत्कीर्तिः
names.meaning: He of true fame; the Lord whose glory is real, imperishable, and celebrated throughout all worlds

names.name: छिन्नसंशयः
names.meaning: He who has destroyed all doubts; the Lord in whom no uncertainty exists and who dispels the doubts of devotees

verses.sanskritDevanagari:
उदीर्णः सर्वतश्चक्षुरनीशः शाश्वतस्थिरः ।
भूशयो भूषणो भूतिर्विशोकः शोकनाशनः ॥ ६७॥
verses.transliteration:
udīrṇaḥ sarvataścakṣuranīśaḥ śāśvatasthiraḥ |
bhūśayo bhūṣaṇo bhūtirviśokaḥ śokanāśanaḥ || 67 ||

names.name: उदीर्णः
names.meaning: The exalted one; He who transcends all beings and is supremely elevated above the entire creation

names.name: सर्वतश्चक्षुः
names.meaning: He whose eyes are everywhere; the omniscient Lord who sees all things in all directions simultaneously

names.name: अनीशः
names.meaning: He who has no master above Him; the absolutely sovereign Lord who is ruled by no one

names.name: शाश्वतस्थिरः
names.meaning: He who is eternally stable; the Lord who is both everlasting and immovably fixed in His supreme nature

names.name: भूशयः
names.meaning: He who rests upon the earth; the Lord who reclines on the ground in His simplicity, as Rama in the forest

names.name: भूषणः
names.meaning: The adorner; He who embellishes the entire universe with beauty or who is Himself the ornament of all worlds

names.name: भूतिः
names.meaning: He who is pure existence and glory; the Lord who is the source of all prosperity and magnificence

names.name: विशोकः
names.meaning: He who is free from all sorrow; the Lord who is untouched by grief, lamentation, or any form of suffering

names.name: शोकनाशनः
names.meaning: The destroyer of sorrow; He who annihilates the grief and suffering of those who take refuge in Him

verses.sanskritDevanagari:
अर्चिष्मानर्चितः कुम्भो विशुद्धात्मा विशोधनः ।
अनिरुद्धोऽप्रतिरथः प्रद्युम्नोऽमितविक्रमः ॥ ६८॥
verses.transliteration:
arciṣmānarcitaḥ kumbho viśuddhātmā viśodhanaḥ |
aniruddho'pratirathaḥ pradyumno'mitavikramaḥ || 68 ||

names.name: अर्चिष्मान्
names.meaning: He who is radiant with light; the Lord who shines with brilliant effulgence like innumerable rays of splendor

names.name: अर्चितः
names.meaning: He who is worshipped; the Lord who is adored by all beings including Brahma, Shiva, and the devas

names.name: कुम्भः
names.meaning: He who contains everything within Himself; the cosmic vessel that holds the entire universe like a pot

names.name: विशुद्धात्मा
names.meaning: He whose Self is supremely pure; the Lord whose nature is absolutely untainted by any trace of impurity

names.name: विशोधनः
names.meaning: The supreme purifier; He who cleanses His devotees of all sins and impurities through His divine grace

names.name: अनिरुद्धः
names.meaning: He who cannot be obstructed; the irresistible Lord whom no force can restrain, also the grandson of Krishna

names.name: अप्रतिरथः
names.meaning: He who has no equal adversary; the matchless warrior whom no chariot-fighter can ever oppose or defeat

names.name: प्रद्युम्नः
names.meaning: He of supreme splendor; the Lord of great brilliance, also the divine son of Krishna and Rukmini

names.name: अमितविक्रमः
names.meaning: He of boundless prowess; the Lord whose valor and heroic stride are immeasurable, as in the Vamana avatara

verses.sanskritDevanagari:
कालनेमिनिहा वीरः शौरिः शूरजनेश्वरः ।
त्रिलोकात्मा त्रिलोकेशः केशवः केशिहा हरिः ॥ ६९॥
verses.transliteration:
kālaneminihā vīraḥ śauriḥ śūrajaneśvaraḥ |
trilokātmā trilokeśaḥ keśavaḥ keśihā hariḥ || 69 ||

names.name: कालनेमिनिहा
names.meaning: The slayer of Kalanemi; He who destroyed the demon Kalanemi, who was an adversary of the gods

names.name: वीरः
names.meaning: The heroic one; He who is supremely valiant and displays unmatched courage in the protection of dharma

names.name: शौरिः
names.meaning: The descendant of Shura; He who was born in the lineage of the heroic Shura, the grandfather of Krishna

names.name: शूरजनेश्वरः
names.meaning: The Lord of the valiant; He who is the master and commander of all heroic and brave beings

names.name: त्रिलोकात्मा
names.meaning: The Self of the three worlds; He who is the indwelling spirit and essence of the celestial, terrestrial, and subterranean realms

names.name: त्रिलोकेशः
names.meaning: The Lord of the three worlds; the supreme sovereign who rules over heaven, earth, and the netherworld

names.name: केशवः
names.meaning: He who has beautiful hair; or He who is the combined form of Brahma (Ka), Shiva (Isha), and Vishnu — the supreme trinity

names.name: केशिहा
names.meaning: The slayer of the demon Keshi; He who as Krishna destroyed the horse-demon Keshi sent by Kamsa

names.name: हरिः
names.meaning: He who removes ignorance and sin; the one who takes away all suffering and who is of captivating green-golden hue

verses.sanskritDevanagari:
कामदेवः कामपालः कामी कान्तः कृतागमः ।
अनिर्देश्यवपुर्विष्णुर्वीरोऽनन्तो धनञ्जयः ॥ ७०॥
verses.transliteration:
kāmadevaḥ kāmapālaḥ kāmī kāntaḥ kṛtāgamaḥ |
anirdeśyavapurviṣṇurvīro'nanto dhanañjayaḥ || 70 ||

names.name: कामदेवः
names.meaning: The God of love and desire; He who is sought after by all beings desiring the four goals of life (dharma, artha, kama, moksha)

names.name: कामपालः
names.meaning: The fulfiller of desires; He who protects and fulfills the legitimate wishes of His devoted seekers

names.name: कामी
names.meaning: He who has fulfilled all desires; the Lord who possesses all that is desirable and whose every wish is already accomplished

names.name: कान्तः
names.meaning: The supremely beautiful one; He who is infinitely attractive and enchanting to all beings

names.name: कृतागमः
names.meaning: The author of the scriptures; He who revealed the Vedas, Agamas, and all sacred texts for the guidance of humanity

names.name: अनिर्देश्यवपुः
names.meaning: He whose form is indescribable; the Lord whose divine body transcends all words, thought, and characterization

names.name: विष्णुः
names.meaning: The all-pervading one; He who permeates every atom of the universe and transcends all spatial limitation

names.name: वीरः
names.meaning: The valiant one; He who displays supreme heroism and moves dynamically through all creation

names.name: अनन्तः
names.meaning: The infinite one; He who is limitless in time, space, and attributes, without beginning or end

names.name: धनञ्जयः
names.meaning: The conqueror of wealth; He who wins over all riches, or the vital air that sustains the body after death

verses.sanskritDevanagari:
ब्रह्मण्यो ब्रह्मकृद् ब्रह्मा ब्रह्म ब्रह्मविवर्धनः ।
ब्रह्मविद् ब्राह्मणो ब्रह्मी ब्रह्मज्ञो ब्राह्मणप्रियः ॥ ७१॥
verses.transliteration:
brahmaṇyo brahmakṛd brahmā brahma brahmavivardhanaḥ |
brahmavid brāhmaṇo brahmī brahmajño brāhmaṇapriyaḥ || 71 ||

names.name: ब्रह्मण्यः
names.meaning: He who is devoted to Brahman; the Lord who supports the Vedas, brahmanas, and all that is sacred and holy

names.name: ब्रह्मकृत्
names.meaning: The creator of Brahma and the Vedas; He who brings into being the creator-god and all sacred knowledge

names.name: ब्रह्मा
names.meaning: He who is Brahma the creator; the Lord who assumes the form of the cosmic creator to fashion the universe

names.name: ब्रह्म
names.meaning: The supreme Brahman; the infinite, absolute reality that is the ground of all existence and consciousness

names.name: ब्रह्मविवर्धनः
names.meaning: He who expands Brahman; the Lord who causes the Vedas and spiritual knowledge to grow and flourish

names.name: ब्रह्मविद्
names.meaning: The knower of Brahman; He who perfectly comprehends the supreme reality in its totality

names.name: ब्राह्मणः
names.meaning: He who is the true brahmana; the Lord who embodies the highest qualities of wisdom, purity, and spiritual knowledge

names.name: ब्रह्मी
names.meaning: He who is endowed with Brahman; the Lord who possesses the supreme reality as His very essence

names.name: ब्रह्मज्ञः
names.meaning: He who knows the Vedas completely; the omniscient Lord who is the ultimate authority on all sacred knowledge

names.name: ब्राह्मणप्रियः
names.meaning: He who is dear to the brahmanas; the Lord who loves those devoted to spiritual knowledge and Vedic learning

verses.sanskritDevanagari:
महाक्रमो महाकर्मा महातेजा महोरगः ।
महाक्रतुर्महायज्वा महायज्ञो महाहविः ॥ ७२॥
verses.transliteration:
mahākramo mahākarmā mahātejā mahoragaḥ |
mahākraturmahāyajvā mahāyajño mahāhaviḥ || 72 ||

names.name: महाक्रमः
names.meaning: He of the great stride; the Lord whose steps span the entire cosmos, as demonstrated in the Vamana avatara

names.name: महाकर्मा
names.meaning: He of great deeds; the Lord whose actions of creation, preservation, and dissolution are supremely magnificent

names.name: महातेजाः
names.meaning: He of great splendor; the Lord whose radiant energy illumines all worlds and surpasses every other brilliance

names.name: महोरगः
names.meaning: The great serpent; He who manifests as Adishesha, the infinite cosmic serpent upon whom He reclines

names.name: महाक्रतुः
names.meaning: The great sacrifice; He who is the supreme yajna and the ultimate purpose of all Vedic sacrificial rites

names.name: महायज्वा
names.meaning: The great performer of sacrifice; He who is the foremost among all those who conduct sacred rituals and offerings

verses.sanskritDevanagari:
स्तव्यः स्तवप्रियः स्तोत्रं स्तुतिः स्तोता रणप्रियः ।
पूर्णः पूरयिता पुण्यः पुण्यकीर्तिरनामयः ॥ ७३॥
verses.transliteration:
stavyaḥ stavapriyaḥ stotraṃ stutiḥ stotā raṇapriyaḥ |
pūrṇaḥ pūrayitā puṇyaḥ puṇyakīrtir anāmayaḥ || 73 ||

names.name: स्तव्य
names.meaning: He who is worthy of praise, being the supreme object of all hymns and laudation.

names.name: स्तवप्रिय
names.meaning: He who delights in the hymns of His devotees, being pleased by sincere praise.

names.name: स्तोत्र
names.meaning: He who is Himself the hymn of praise, being the very essence of devotional eulogy.

names.name: स्तुति
names.meaning: He who is the act of praising itself, the praise that flows toward the Divine.

names.name: स्तोता
names.meaning: He who is the praiser, being present as the consciousness in the one who offers praise.

names.name: रणप्रिय
names.meaning: He who delights in righteous battle, the warrior who rejoices in the fight against adharma.

names.name: पूर्ण
names.meaning: He who is complete and full in every respect, lacking nothing whatsoever.

names.name: पूरयिता
names.meaning: He who fulfils the desires and aspirations of all beings.

names.name: पुण्य
names.meaning: He who is supremely holy, whose very remembrance purifies the mind.

names.name: पुण्यकीर्ति
names.meaning: He whose fame is sacred, whose glory sanctifies all who hear it.

names.name: अनामय
names.meaning: He who is free from all disease and affliction, the embodiment of perfect health.

verses.sanskritDevanagari:
मनोजवस्तीर्थकरो वसुरेता वसुप्रदः ।
वसुप्रदो वासुदेवो वसुर्वसुमना हविः ॥ ७४॥
verses.transliteration:
manojavastīrthakaro vasuretā vasupradaḥ |
vasuprado vāsudevo vasurvasumanā haviḥ || 74 ||

names.name: मनोजव
names.meaning: He who is swift as thought, whose movement is as fast as the mind itself.

names.name: तीर्थकर
names.meaning: He who is the creator of sacred fords, establishing the means of crossing the ocean of samsara.

names.name: वसुरेता
names.meaning: He whose seed is golden, the source from which all wealth and creation spring forth.

names.name: वसुप्रद
names.meaning: He who bestows wealth and riches upon His devotees.

names.name: वसुप्रद
names.meaning: He who grants the supreme wealth of liberation, distinct from material riches.

names.name: वासुदेव
names.meaning: He who is the son of Vasudeva, and who dwells in all beings as the indwelling Self.

names.name: वसु
names.meaning: He who is Himself the wealth sought by all, the ultimate treasure of existence.

names.name: वसुमनस्
names.meaning: He whose mind is pure like gold, whose thoughts are always directed toward the welfare of beings.

names.name: हवि
names.meaning: He who is the oblation itself, the sacred offering poured into the fire of knowledge.

verses.sanskritDevanagari:
सद्गतिः सत्कृतिः सत्ता सद्भूतिः सत्परायणः ।
शूरसेनो यदुश्रेष्ठः सन्निवासः सुयामुनः ॥ ७५॥
verses.transliteration:
sadgatiḥ satkṛtiḥ sattā sadbhūtiḥ satparāyaṇaḥ |
śūraseno yaduśreṣṭhaḥ sannivāsaḥ suyāmunaḥ || 75 ||

names.name: सद्गति
names.meaning: He who is the supreme goal of the righteous, the highest destination for the virtuous.

names.name: सत्कृति
names.meaning: He whose actions are always good and beneficial, the performer of noble deeds.

names.name: सत्ता
names.meaning: He who is Existence itself, the pure Being that underlies all that exists.

names.name: सद्भूति
names.meaning: He who is the true prosperity, the real wealth that manifests as righteous glory.

names.name: सत्परायण
names.meaning: He who is the supreme refuge of the good, the ultimate shelter for the righteous.

names.name: शूरसेन
names.meaning: He who commands heroic armies, the lord of valiant warriors.

names.name: यदुश्रेष्ठ
names.meaning: He who is the foremost among the Yadavas, the best of the Yadu clan.

names.name: सन्निवास
names.meaning: He who is the abode of the virtuous, the dwelling place of all good beings.

names.name: सुयामुन
names.meaning: He who is associated with the sacred Yamuna river, dwelling on its blessed banks.

verses.sanskritDevanagari:
भूतावासो वासुदेवः सर्वासुनिलयोऽनलः ।
दर्पहा दर्पदो दृप्तो दुर्धरोऽथापराजितः ॥ ७६॥
verses.transliteration:
bhūtāvāso vāsudevaḥ sarvāsunilayo'nalaḥ |
darpahā darpado dṛpto durdharo'thāparājitaḥ || 76 ||

names.name: भूतावास
names.meaning: He who is the dwelling place of all beings, in whom all creatures reside.

names.name: वासुदेव
names.meaning: He who veils the universe with His maya and yet dwells within all as the inner Self.

names.name: सर्वासुनिलय
names.meaning: He who is the abode of all life-breaths, the resting place of every living force.

names.name: अनल
names.meaning: He who is fire, possessing infinite energy and the power of digestion and transformation.

names.name: दर्पहा
names.meaning: He who destroys the pride of those who oppose dharma.

names.name: दर्पद
names.meaning: He who bestows justified confidence and noble pride upon His devotees.

names.name: दृप्त
names.meaning: He who is ever exuberant with the fullness of His own divine glory.

names.name: दुर्धर
names.meaning: He who is difficult to bear or contain, whose power is beyond comprehension.

names.name: अपराजित
names.meaning: He who is never conquered by anyone, the eternally invincible one.

verses.sanskritDevanagari:
विश्वमूर्तिर्महामूर्तिर्दीप्तमूर्तिरमूर्तिमान्।
अनेकमूर्तिरव्यक्तः शतमूर्तिः शताननः ॥ ७७॥
verses.transliteration:
viśvamūrtirmahāmūrtirdīptamūrtiramūrtimān |
anekamūrtiravyaktaḥ śatamūrtiḥ śatānanaḥ || 77 ||

names.name: विश्वमूर्ति
names.meaning: He whose form is the entire universe, the cosmic form encompassing all creation.

names.name: महामूर्ति
names.meaning: He whose form is infinitely vast and grand, transcending all measure.

names.name: दीप्तमूर्ति
names.meaning: He whose form is blazing with divine radiance and effulgent splendour.

names.name: अमूर्तिमान्
names.meaning: He who possesses no material form, being beyond all physical manifestation yet present everywhere.

names.name: अनेकमूर्ति
names.meaning: He who has innumerable forms, manifesting in countless ways across creation.

names.name: अव्यक्त
names.meaning: He who is unmanifest, not perceivable by the senses or the ordinary mind.

names.name: शतमूर्ति
names.meaning: He who has hundreds of forms, appearing in diverse manifestations for the sake of devotees.

names.name: शतानन
names.meaning: He who has a hundred faces, seeing in all directions simultaneously.

verses.sanskritDevanagari:
एको नैकः सवः कः किं यत्तत्पदमनुत्तमम्।
लोकबन्धुर्लोकनाथो माधवो भक्तवत्सलः ॥ ७८॥
verses.transliteration:
eko naikaḥ savaḥ kaḥ kiṃ yattatpadamanuttamam |
lokabandhurlokānātho mādhavo bhaktavatsalaḥ || 78 ||

names.name: एक
names.meaning: He who is the One without a second, the non-dual reality underlying all existence.

names.name: नैक
names.meaning: He who is also the many, manifesting as the multiplicity of forms in creation.

names.name: सव
names.meaning: He who is the Soma sacrifice, the Lord who is the essence of all sacred rituals.

names.name: क
names.meaning: He who is Brahma the creator, denoted by the syllable 'ka' which signifies joy.

names.name: किम्
names.meaning: He who is worthy of inquiry, the ultimate subject of all philosophical questioning.

names.name: यत्
names.meaning: He who is That which exists, the reality referred to as 'That' in the Upanishads.

names.name: तत्
names.meaning: He who is 'That' supreme Brahman indicated by the word Tat in 'Tat tvam asi'.

names.name: पदमनुत्तम
names.meaning: He who is the supreme state, the unsurpassed goal from which there is no higher attainment.

names.name: लोकबन्धु
names.meaning: He who is the kinsman of the entire world, the universal friend of all beings.

names.name: लोकनाथ
names.meaning: He who is the lord and protector of all the worlds.

names.name: माधव
names.meaning: He who is the consort of Lakshmi (Ma), and the descendant of the Madhu clan.

names.name: भक्तवत्सल
names.meaning: He who is supremely affectionate toward His devotees, tender as a mother to her calf.

verses.sanskritDevanagari:
सुवर्णवर्णो हेमाङ्गो वराङ्गश्चन्दनाङ्गदी ।
वीरहा विषमः शून्यो घृताशीरचलश्चलः ॥ ७९॥
verses.transliteration:
suvarṇavarṇo hemāṅgo varāṅgaścandanāṅgadī |
vīrahā viṣamaḥ śūnyo ghṛtāśīracalaścalaḥ || 79 ||

names.name: सुवर्णवर्ण
names.meaning: He whose complexion is like gold, radiating a lustrous golden hue.

names.name: हेमाङ्ग
names.meaning: He whose limbs are golden, whose divine body shines like pure gold.

names.name: वराङ्ग
names.meaning: He whose limbs are beautiful and noble, possessing the most excellent form.

names.name: चन्दनाङ्गदी
names.meaning: He who wears armlets adorned with sandalwood paste, fragrant and resplendent.

names.name: वीरहा
names.meaning: He who destroys mighty warriors who oppose dharma.

names.name: विषम
names.meaning: He who is unequalled, having no peer or parallel in all of existence.

names.name: शून्य
names.meaning: He who appears void to those without devotion, being imperceptible to the ignorant.

names.name: घृताशी
names.meaning: He who consumes ghee oblations, the receiver of clarified butter offered in sacrifice.

names.name: अचल
names.meaning: He who is immovable, firmly established and never shaken from His nature.

names.name: चल
names.meaning: He who moves as the wind and as the life-force in all living beings.

verses.sanskritDevanagari:
अमानी मानदो मान्यो लोकस्वामी त्रिलोकधृक् ।
सुमेधा मेधजो धन्यः सत्यमेधा धराधरः ॥ ८०॥
verses.transliteration:
amānī mānado mānyo lokasvāmī trilokadhṛk |
sumedhā medhajo dhanyaḥ satyamedhā dharādharaḥ || 80 ||

names.name: अमानिन्
names.meaning: He who is without pride, free from vanity despite being the Lord of all.

names.name: मानद
names.meaning: He who bestows honour and respect upon the deserving.

names.name: मान्य
names.meaning: He who is worthy of the highest reverence from all beings.

names.name: लोकस्वामिन्
names.meaning: He who is the sovereign lord of all the worlds.

names.name: त्रिलोकधृक्
names.meaning: He who upholds and sustains the three worlds — earth, heaven, and the intermediate realm.

names.name: सुमेधस्
names.meaning: He who possesses supreme intelligence and the most excellent wisdom.

names.name: मेधज
names.meaning: He who is born of sacrificial rites, manifesting through sacred yajna.

names.name: धन्य
names.meaning: He who is supremely blessed and the bestower of good fortune.

names.name: सत्यमेधस्
names.meaning: He whose intelligence is truth itself, whose wisdom never errs.

names.name: धराधर
names.meaning: He who supports the earth, bearing the world as the cosmic sustainer.

verses.sanskritDevanagari:
तेजोवृषो द्युतिधरः सर्वशस्त्रभृतां वरः ।
प्रग्रहो निग्रहो व्यग्रो नैकश‍ृङ्गो गदाग्रजः ॥ ८१॥
verses.transliteration:
tejovṛṣo dyutidharaḥ sarvaśastrabhṛtāṃ varaḥ |
pragraho nigraho vyagro naikaśṛṅgo gadāgrajaḥ || 81 ||

names.name: तेजोवृष
names.meaning: He who showers radiance, raining down spiritual brilliance upon devotees.

names.name: द्युतिधर
names.meaning: He who bears divine effulgence, the carrier of celestial luminosity.

names.name: सर्वशस्त्रभृतां वर
names.meaning: He who is the best among all who wield weapons, the supreme warrior.

names.name: प्रग्रह
names.meaning: He who graciously accepts offerings, and who controls all with His guiding hand.

names.name: निग्रह
names.meaning: He who restrains and subdues the wicked, bringing them under control.

names.name: व्यग्र
names.meaning: He who is ever engaged in the welfare of the worlds, ceaselessly active in sustaining creation.

names.name: नैकशृङ्ग
names.meaning: He who has many horns, referring to the Matsya avatara with the great horn, or the many-peaked cosmic form.

names.name: गदाग्रज
names.meaning: He who is the elder brother of Gada, being Krishna the elder sibling of Gada.

verses.sanskritDevanagari:
चतुर्मूर्तिश्चतुर्बाहुश्चतुर्व्यूहश्चतुर्गतिः ।
चतुरात्मा चतुर्भावश्चतुर्वेदविदेकपात्॥ ८२॥
verses.transliteration:
caturmūrtiścaturbāhuścaturvyūhaścaturgatiḥ |
caturātmā caturbhāvaścaturvedavidekapāt || 82 ||

names.name: चतुर्मूर्ति
names.meaning: He who has four forms — Vasudeva, Sankarshana, Pradyumna, and Aniruddha.

names.name: चतुर्बाहु
names.meaning: He who has four arms, bearing the conch, discus, mace, and lotus.

names.name: चतुर्व्यूह
names.meaning: He who manifests as the four vyuhas — the fourfold emanation of divine powers.

names.name: चतुर्गति
names.meaning: He who is the goal of all four types of seekers — the distressed, the curious, the wealth-seeker, and the wise.

names.name: चतुरात्मन्
names.meaning: He who has a fourfold Self, presiding over mind, intellect, ego, and consciousness.

names.name: चतुर्भाव
names.meaning: He who is the origin of the four purusharthas — dharma, artha, kama, and moksha.

names.name: चतुर्वेदविद्
names.meaning: He who is the knower of all four Vedas — Rig, Yajur, Sama, and Atharva.

names.name: एकपाद्
names.meaning: He who pervades the transcendent realm with one foot, three-quarters of His glory being beyond creation.

verses.sanskritDevanagari:
समावर्तोऽनिवृत्तात्मा दुर्जयो दुरतिक्रमः ।
दुर्लभो दुर्गमो दुर्गो दुरावासो दुरारिहा ॥ ८३॥
verses.transliteration:
samāvarto'nivṛttātmā durjayo duratikramaḥ |
durlabho durgamo durgo durāvāso durārihā || 83 ||

names.name: समावर्त
names.meaning: He who turns the wheel of samsara, governing the cycle of birth, death, and rebirth.

names.name: अनिवृत्तात्मन्
names.meaning: He whose Self is never withdrawn from anything, being omnipresent and ever-engaged.

names.name: दुर्जय
names.meaning: He who is difficult to conquer, invincible by any force in all the three worlds.

names.name: दुरतिक्रम
names.meaning: He whose commands cannot be transgressed, whose divine law none can surpass.

names.name: दुर्लभ
names.meaning: He who is difficult to attain, reachable only through intense devotion and surrender.

names.name: दुर्गम
names.meaning: He who is difficult to approach, accessible only to those of pure heart.

names.name: दुर्ग
names.meaning: He who is like an impregnable fortress, the protector who is Himself the ultimate refuge.

names.name: दुरावास
names.meaning: He whose true abode is difficult to reach, residing in the supreme Vaikuntha.

names.name: दुरारिहन्
names.meaning: He who slays the enemies that are difficult to vanquish, destroying formidable foes of dharma.

verses.sanskritDevanagari:
शुभाङ्गो लोकसारङ्गः सुतन्तुस्तन्तुवर्धनः ।
इन्द्रकर्मा महाकर्मा कृतकर्मा कृतागमः ॥ ८४॥
verses.transliteration:
śubhāṅgo lokasāraṅgaḥ sutantustantuvardhanaḥ |
indrakarmā mahākarmā kṛtakarmā kṛtāgamaḥ || 84 ||

names.name: शुभाङ्ग
names.meaning: He whose limbs are auspicious, whose every part radiates beauty and blessedness.

names.name: लोकसारङ्ग
names.meaning: He who extracts the essence of the worlds, knowing the true substance of all existence.

names.name: सुतन्तु
names.meaning: He who has an excellent lineage, whose thread of creation is beautifully woven.

names.name: तन्तुवर्धन
names.meaning: He who expands the web of creation, causing the fabric of the universe to grow.

names.name: इन्द्रकर्मन्
names.meaning: He whose deeds are like those of Indra, performing supremely powerful actions.

names.name: महाकर्मन्
names.meaning: He whose actions are great and magnificent, performing cosmic deeds of creation and preservation.

names.name: कृतकर्मन्
names.meaning: He who has accomplished all that needs to be done, being eternally fulfilled in action.

names.name: कृतागम
names.meaning: He who is the author of the Agamas and sacred scriptures, the revealer of divine knowledge.

verses.sanskritDevanagari:
उद्भवः सुन्दरः सुन्दो रत्ननाभः सुलोचनः ।
अर्को वाजसनः श‍ृङ्गी जयन्तः सर्वविज्जयी ॥ ८५॥
verses.transliteration:
udbhavaḥ sundaraḥ sundo ratnanābhaḥ sulocanaḥ |
arko vājasanaḥ śṛṅgī jayantaḥ sarvavijjayī || 85 ||

names.name: उद्भव
names.meaning: He who is the origin of all, the supreme source from which the universe arises.

names.name: सुन्दर
names.meaning: He who is supremely beautiful, the embodiment of divine loveliness.

names.name: सुन्द
names.meaning: He who is tender and compassionate, soft-hearted toward all beings.

names.name: रत्ननाभ
names.meaning: He whose navel is beautiful like a jewel, from which the lotus of creation emerges.

names.name: सुलोचन
names.meaning: He who has beautiful eyes, whose gracious gaze blesses all who behold Him.

names.name: अर्क
names.meaning: He who is worshipped and praised, being the radiant one like the sun.

names.name: वाजसन
names.meaning: He who grants nourishment and strength, the bestower of food and vitality.

names.name: शृङ्गिन्
names.meaning: He who has a horn, as the great Matsya (fish) avatara who bore the horn to save creation.

names.name: जयन्त
names.meaning: He who is ever victorious, the conqueror who triumphs over all adversaries.

names.name: सर्वविज्जयिन्
names.meaning: He who conquers all the wise and knowledgeable, being the supreme among the omniscient.

verses.sanskritDevanagari:
सुवर्णबिन्दुरक्षोभ्यः सर्ववागीश्वरेश्वरः ।
महाह्रदो महागर्तो महाभूतो महानिधिः ॥ ८६॥
verses.transliteration:
suvarṇabindur akṣobhyaḥ sarvavāgīśvareśvaraḥ |
mahāhrado mahāgarto mahābhūto mahānidhiḥ || 86 ||

names.name: सुवर्णबिन्दु
names.meaning: He who has a golden mark, bearing the auspicious mole called Shrivatsa on His chest.

names.name: अक्षोभ्य
names.meaning: He who is imperturbable, never agitated or disturbed by anything.

names.name: सर्ववागीश्वरेश्वर
names.meaning: He who is the Lord of all lords of speech, the master of all eloquence and knowledge.

names.name: महाह्रद
names.meaning: He who is like a vast, deep lake, unfathomable and inexhaustible in His nature.

names.name: महागर्त
names.meaning: He who is the great abyss, the infinite depth that can never be fully fathomed.

names.name: महाभूत
names.meaning: He who is the great being, the supreme entity from whom the five great elements originate.

names.name: महानिधि
names.meaning: He who is the great treasure, the inexhaustible storehouse of all that is precious.

verses.sanskritDevanagari:
कुमुदः कुन्दरः कुन्दः पर्जन्यः पावनोऽनिलः ।
अमृताशोऽमृतवपुः सर्वज्ञः सर्वतोमुखः ॥ ८७॥
verses.transliteration:
kumudaḥ kundaraḥ kundaḥ parjanyaḥ pāvano'nilaḥ |
amṛtāśo'mṛtavapuḥ sarvajñaḥ sarvatomukhaḥ || 87 ||

names.name: कुमुद
names.meaning: He who delights the earth, bringing joy to the world like the water-lily that gladdens the waters.

names.name: कुन्दर
names.meaning: He who bestows the reward of liberation, the giver of the supreme gift.

names.name: कुन्द
names.meaning: He who is pure and white like the jasmine flower, spotless in His nature.

names.name: पर्जन्य
names.meaning: He who is like the rain-cloud, showering blessings upon the parched world.

names.name: पावन
names.meaning: He who purifies all, whose very name cleanses the mind of impurities.

names.name: अनिल
names.meaning: He who is the wind, the cosmic breath that sustains all life.

names.name: अमृताश
names.meaning: He who feeds on immortal nectar, the consumer of the deathless essence.

names.name: अमृतवपु
names.meaning: He whose body is immortal, whose divine form is made of deathless nectar.

names.name: सर्वज्ञ
names.meaning: He who is omniscient, knowing everything in all times and all places.

names.name: सर्वतोमुख
names.meaning: He who faces in every direction, whose awareness pervades all quarters.

verses.sanskritDevanagari:
सुलभः सुव्रतः सिद्धः शत्रुजिच्छत्रुतापनः ।
न्यग्रोधोऽदुम्बरोऽश्वत्थश्चाणूरान्ध्रनिषूदनः ॥ ८८॥
verses.transliteration:
sulabhaḥ suvrataḥ siddhaḥ śatrujicChatrutāpanaḥ |
nyagrodho'dumbaro'śvatthaścāṇūrāndhranishūdanaḥ || 88 ||

names.name: सुलभ
names.meaning: He who is easily attainable by those who approach Him with sincere devotion.

names.name: सुव्रत
names.meaning: He who has taken the noblest of vows — to protect those who surrender to Him.

names.name: सिद्ध
names.meaning: He who is eternally perfected, having already attained all that can be attained.

names.name: शत्रुजित्
names.meaning: He who conquers all enemies, vanquishing every foe of righteousness.

names.name: शत्रुतापन
names.meaning: He who torments His enemies, causing anguish to those who oppose dharma.

names.name: न्यग्रोध
names.meaning: He who is like the banyan tree, under which all beings find shelter and shade.

names.name: अदुम्बर
names.meaning: He who is like the sacred fig tree, present above all celestial realms as the supreme Lord.

names.name: अश्वत्थ
names.meaning: He who is the sacred Peepal tree, the tree of samsara rooted in Brahman.

names.name: चाणूरान्ध्रनिषूदन
names.meaning: He who slew the wrestler Chanura, the destroyer of the tyrant Andhra.

verses.sanskritDevanagari:
सहस्रार्चिः सप्तजिह्वः सप्तैधाः सप्तवाहनः ।
अमूर्तिरनघोऽचिन्त्यो भयकृद्भयनाशनः ॥ ८९॥
verses.transliteration:
sahasrārciḥ saptajihvaḥ saptaidhāḥ saptavāhanaḥ |
amūrtiranagho'cintyo bhayakṛdbhayanāśanaḥ || 89 ||

names.name: सहस्रार्चि
names.meaning: He who has a thousand rays, blazing with innumerable beams of divine light.

names.name: सप्तजिह्व
names.meaning: He who has seven tongues of fire, the sevenfold flame that consumes all offerings.

names.name: सप्तैधस्
names.meaning: He who has seven forms of fuel, the Lord of the seven types of sacred fire.

names.name: सप्तवाहन
names.meaning: He whose vehicle has seven horses, like the Sun-god drawn by seven steeds.

names.name: अमूर्ति
names.meaning: He who is formless, beyond all physical shape and material embodiment.

names.name: अनघ
names.meaning: He who is sinless, completely free from any trace of fault or transgression.

names.name: अचिन्त्य
names.meaning: He who is inconceivable, beyond the reach of thought and mental comprehension.

names.name: भयकृत्
names.meaning: He who creates fear in the hearts of the wicked and the unrighteous.

names.name: भयनाशन
names.meaning: He who destroys all fear, removing terror from the hearts of His devotees.

verses.sanskritDevanagari:
अणुर्बृहत्कृशः स्थूलो गुणभृन्निर्गुणो महान्।
अधृतः स्वधृतः स्वास्यः प्राग्वंशो वंशवर्धनः ॥ ९०॥
verses.transliteration:
aṇurbṛhatkṛśaḥ sthūlo guṇabhṛnnirguṇo mahān |
adhṛtaḥ svadhṛtaḥ svāsyaḥ prāgvaṃśo vaṃśavardhanaḥ || 90 ||

names.name: अणु
names.meaning: He who is subtler than the subtlest, smaller than the smallest atom.

names.name: बृहत्
names.meaning: He who is infinitely vast, greater than the greatest conceivable magnitude.

names.name: कृश
names.meaning: He who is slender, being subtle and refined beyond all material thickness.

names.name: स्थूल
names.meaning: He who is immense in His cosmic form, appearing as the gross totality of the universe.

names.name: गुणभृत्
names.meaning: He who sustains the three gunas — sattva, rajas, and tamas — as the basis of all creation.

names.name: निर्गुण
names.meaning: He who is beyond all material qualities, transcending the three gunas entirely.

names.name: महान्
names.meaning: He who is the great one, supreme in every aspect of being and glory.

names.name: अधृत
names.meaning: He who is unsupported, needing no other foundation as He is self-existent.

names.name: स्वधृत
names.meaning: He who is self-supported, sustaining Himself by His own infinite power.

names.name: स्वास्य
names.meaning: He who has a beautiful face, whose countenance is gracious and lovely.

names.name: प्राग्वंश
names.meaning: He who belongs to the most ancient lineage, existing before all dynasties and creation.

names.name: वंशवर्धन
names.meaning: He who causes His dynasty to flourish, expanding the lineage of the righteous.

verses.sanskritDevanagari:
भारभृत्कथितो योगी योगीशः सर्वकामदः ।
आश्रमः श्रमणः क्षामः सुपर्णो वायुवाहनः ॥ ९१॥
verses.transliteration:
bhārabhṛtkathito yogī yogīśaḥ sarvakāmadaḥ |
āśramaḥ śramaṇaḥ kṣāmaḥ suparṇo vāyuvāhanaḥ || 91 ||

names.name: भारभृत्
names.meaning: He who bears the burden of the entire universe, supporting it without effort.

names.name: कथित
names.meaning: He who is spoken of in all the Vedas and scriptures as the Supreme Being.

names.name: योगिन्
names.meaning: He who is the supreme yogi, the master of all yoga and contemplative union.

names.name: योगीश
names.meaning: He who is the lord of all yogis, the master whom all practitioners worship.

names.name: सर्वकामद
names.meaning: He who fulfils all desires, granting every wish of those who pray to Him.

names.name: आश्रम
names.meaning: He who is the place of rest, the hermitage where weary souls find peace.

names.name: श्रमण
names.meaning: He who causes the exertion of seekers, and who Himself performs austerities.

names.name: क्षाम
names.meaning: He who diminishes and destroys all samsaric existence for the liberated.

names.name: सुपर्ण
names.meaning: He who has beautiful wings, manifesting as Garuda and the sacred Vedic bird.

names.name: वायुवाहन
names.meaning: He who directs the wind, the controller of Vayu and all vital breaths.

verses.sanskritDevanagari:
धनुर्धरो धनुर्वेदो दण्डो दमयिता दमः ।
अपराजितः सर्वसहो नियन्ताऽनियमोऽयमः ॥ ९२॥
verses.transliteration:
dhanurdharo dhanurvedo daṇḍo damayitā damaḥ |
aparājitaḥ sarvasaho niyantā'niyamo'yamaḥ || 92 ||

names.name: धनुर्धर
names.meaning: He who wields the bow, bearing the divine Sharnga bow in His mighty hands.

names.name: धनुर्वेद
names.meaning: He who is the master of the science of archery and all martial arts.

names.name: दण्ड
names.meaning: He who is the rod of punishment, chastising the wicked for the sake of cosmic order.

names.name: दमयिता
names.meaning: He who subdues and tames, bringing the unruly under the control of dharma.

names.name: दम
names.meaning: He who is self-restraint itself, the embodiment of discipline and control.

names.name: अपराजित
names.meaning: He who is unconquered, never defeated in any battle or contest.

names.name: सर्वसह
names.meaning: He who endures everything, bearing all with infinite patience and forbearance.

names.name: नियन्ता
names.meaning: He who regulates and governs all beings, directing the course of the universe.

names.name: अनियम
names.meaning: He who is not subject to any rule or regulation, being supremely free and sovereign.

names.name: अयम
names.meaning: He who is without death, free from the lord of death and all cessation.

verses.sanskritDevanagari:
सत्त्ववान्सात्त्विकः सत्यः सत्यधर्मपरायणः ।
अभिप्रायः प्रियार्होऽर्हः प्रियकृत्प्रीतिवर्धनः ॥ ९३॥
verses.transliteration:
sattvavānsāttvikaḥ satyaḥ satyadharmaparāyaṇaḥ |
abhiprāyaḥ priyārho'rhaḥ priyakṛtprītivardhanaḥ || 93 ||

names.name: सत्त्ववत्
names.meaning: He who is full of sattva, abounding in the quality of purity, goodness, and light.

names.name: सात्त्विक
names.meaning: He who is of the nature of pure sattva, free from rajas and tamas.

names.name: सत्य
names.meaning: He who is Truth itself, the ultimate reality that never changes or deceives.

names.name: सत्यधर्मपरायण
names.meaning: He who is wholly devoted to truth and righteousness, the refuge of satya and dharma.

names.name: अभिप्राय
names.meaning: He who is the ultimate purpose and intention behind all existence.

names.name: प्रियार्ह
names.meaning: He who deserves the most loving offerings and the dearest gifts of devotion.

names.name: अर्ह
names.meaning: He who is worthy of worship, deserving the highest veneration from all beings.

names.name: प्रियकृत्
names.meaning: He who does what is pleasing and beneficial to His devotees.

names.name: प्रीतिवर्धन
names.meaning: He who increases the joy and delight of those who love Him.

verses.sanskritDevanagari:
विहायसगतिर्ज्योतिः सुरुचिर्हुतभुग्विभुः ।
रविर्विरोचनः सूर्यः सविता रविलोचनः ॥ ९४॥
verses.transliteration:
vihāyasagatirjyotiḥ surucirhutabhugvibhuḥ |
avirvirocanaḥ sūryaḥ savitā ravilocanaḥ || 94 ||

names.name: विहायसगति
names.meaning: He who moves through the sky, traversing the heavens with effortless freedom.

names.name: ज्योतिस्
names.meaning: He who is the divine light, the self-luminous radiance illuminating all worlds.

names.name: सुरुचि
names.meaning: He who has excellent lustre, shining with beautiful and captivating brilliance.

names.name: हुतभुक्
names.meaning: He who enjoys the oblations offered in the sacred fire by devoted worshippers.

names.name: विभु
names.meaning: He who is all-pervading, present everywhere and in everything without limitation.

names.name: रवि
names.meaning: He who is the sun, the supreme source of light and life-giving energy.

names.name: विरोचन
names.meaning: He who illuminates everything, shining brilliantly across all realms of existence.

names.name: सूर्य
names.meaning: He who is the solar deity, the cosmic luminary who generates and sustains life.

names.name: सविता
names.meaning: He who is the progenitor, the divine creator who brings forth all beings.

names.name: रविलोचन
names.meaning: He whose eyes are the sun, who sees the world through the radiance of solar light.

verses.sanskritDevanagari:
अनन्तो हुतभुग्भोक्ता सुखदो नैकजोऽग्रजः ।
अनिर्विण्णः सदामर्षी लोकाधिष्ठानमद्भुतः ॥ ९५॥
verses.transliteration:
ananto hutabhugbhoktā sukhado naikajo'grajaḥ |
anirviṇṇaḥ sadāmarṣī lokādhiṣṭhānamadbhutaḥ || 95 ||

names.name: अनन्त
names.meaning: He who is infinite, without end in time, space, or any attribute.

names.name: हुतभुग्भोक्ता
names.meaning: He who enjoys the offerings consumed by fire, being the ultimate recipient of all sacrifices.

names.name: सुखद
names.meaning: He who grants happiness, bestowing the bliss of liberation upon His devotees.

names.name: नैकज
names.meaning: He who is born many times, taking multiple incarnations for the welfare of the world.

names.name: अग्रज
names.meaning: He who was born before all others, the firstborn of all creation.

names.name: अनिर्विण्ण
names.meaning: He who is never despondent, free from weariness, dejection, and discouragement.

names.name: सदामर्षिन्
names.meaning: He who is ever forgiving, perpetually patient with the transgressions of beings.

names.name: लोकाधिष्ठान
names.meaning: He who is the substratum of all worlds, the foundation upon which the universe rests.

names.name: अद्भुत
names.meaning: He who is wonderful and marvellous, whose nature inspires awe and astonishment.

verses.sanskritDevanagari:
सनात्सनातनतमः कपिलः कपिरव्ययः ।
स्वस्तिदः स्वस्तिकृत्स्वस्ति स्वस्तिभुक्स्वस्तिदक्षिणः ॥ ९६॥
verses.transliteration:
sanātsanātanatamaḥ kapilaḥ kapiravyayaḥ |
svastidaḥ svastikṛtsvasti svastibhuksvastidakṣiṇaḥ || 96 ||

names.name: सनात्
names.meaning: He who is the ancient eternal being, existing since before time itself began.

names.name: सनातनतम
names.meaning: He who is the most ancient of all, more eternal than even the concept of eternity.

names.name: कपिल
names.meaning: He who is the great sage Kapila, the founder of the Sankhya philosophy and avatara of Vishnu.

names.name: कपि
names.meaning: He who is the divine boar, or the tawny-coloured one who drinks the waters of creation.

names.name: अव्यय
names.meaning: He who is imperishable, never subject to decay, diminution, or destruction.

names.name: स्वस्तिद
names.meaning: He who grants auspiciousness and well-being to all creatures.

names.name: स्वस्तिकृत्
names.meaning: He who creates auspiciousness, the maker of all that is good and blessed.

names.name: स्वस्ति
names.meaning: He who is auspiciousness itself, the embodiment of benediction and grace.

names.name: स्वस्तिभुक्
names.meaning: He who enjoys and protects auspiciousness, safeguarding the well-being of the universe.

names.name: स्वस्तिदक्षिण
names.meaning: He who is proficient in granting auspiciousness, or whose dakshina itself is svasti.

verses.sanskritDevanagari:
अरौद्रः कुण्डली चक्री विक्रम्यूर्जितशासनः ।
शब्दातिगः शब्दसहः शिशिरः शर्वरीकरः ॥ ९७॥
verses.transliteration:
araudraḥ kuṇḍalī cakrī vikramyūrjitaśāsanaḥ |
śabdātigaḥ śabdasahaḥ śiśiraḥ śarvarīkaraḥ || 97 ||

names.name: अरौद्र
names.meaning: He who is free from anger and ferocity, ever gentle and compassionate in His nature.

names.name: कुण्डलिन्
names.meaning: He who wears resplendent earrings, adorned with brilliant divine ornaments.

names.name: चक्रिन्
names.meaning: He who bears the Sudarshana discus, the wielder of the supreme cosmic wheel.

names.name: विक्रमिन्
names.meaning: He who is valorous, possessing supreme prowess as displayed by Vamana's cosmic strides.

names.name: ऊर्जितशासन
names.meaning: He whose commands are mighty and inviolable, whose governance is supremely powerful.

names.name: शब्दातिग
names.meaning: He who transcends all words, beyond the reach of speech and verbal description.

names.name: शब्दसह
names.meaning: He who endures and sustains all sounds, the basis of all verbal testimony and revelation.

names.name: शिशिर
names.meaning: He who is cool and refreshing, providing comfort like the cool season to those burning in samsara.

names.name: शर्वरीकर
names.meaning: He who creates the night, bringing rest and darkness for the rejuvenation of all beings.

verses.sanskritDevanagari:
अक्रूरः पेशलो दक्षो दक्षिणः क्षमिणांवरः ।
विद्वत्तमो वीतभयः पुण्यश्रवणकीर्तनः ॥ ९८॥
verses.transliteration:
akrūraḥ peśalo dakṣo dakṣiṇaḥ kṣamiṇāṃvaraḥ |
vidvattamo vītabhayaḥ puṇyaśravaṇakīrtanaḥ || 98 ||

names.name: अक्रूर
names.meaning: He who is not cruel, ever kind and gentle in His dealings with all beings.

names.name: पेशल
names.meaning: He who is supremely skilful and charming, delicate and artful in all His ways.

names.name: दक्ष
names.meaning: He who is supremely capable and dexterous, swift and alert in all undertakings.

names.name: दक्षिण
names.meaning: He who is liberal and gracious, generous to all and skilled in every art.

names.name: क्षमिणां वर
names.meaning: He who is the best among the patient, the foremost of those who practise forbearance.

names.name: विद्वत्तम
names.meaning: He who is the wisest of the wise, possessing the greatest learning among all knowers.

names.name: वीतभय
names.meaning: He who is completely free from fear, the one in whom no trace of terror exists.

names.name: पुण्यश्रवणकीर्तन
names.meaning: He whose hearing and singing are meritorious, purifying those who listen to or recite His names.

verses.sanskritDevanagari:
उत्तारणो दुष्कृतिहा पुण्यो दुःस्वप्ननाशनः ।
वीरहा रक्षणः सन्तो जीवनः पर्यवस्थितः ॥ ९९॥
verses.transliteration:
uttāraṇo duṣkṛtihā puṇyo duḥsvapnanāśanaḥ |
vīrahā rakṣaṇaḥ santo jīvanaḥ paryavasthitaḥ || 99 ||

names.name: उत्तारण
names.meaning: He who rescues beings from the ocean of samsara, lifting them to the shore of liberation.

names.name: दुष्कृतिहन्
names.meaning: He who destroys the effects of evil deeds, removing the sins of those who seek Him.

names.name: पुण्य
names.meaning: He who is supremely meritorious, the source and embodiment of all sacred virtue.

names.name: दुःस्वप्ननाशन
names.meaning: He who destroys nightmares, dispelling all bad dreams and inauspicious visions.

names.name: वीरहन्
names.meaning: He who slays powerful heroes who oppose dharma, the vanquisher of mighty adversaries.

names.name: रक्षण
names.meaning: He who is the protector, guarding all beings from harm and destruction.

names.name: सन्त
names.meaning: He who is the embodiment of goodness, the virtuous one who is the refuge of the saintly.

names.name: जीवन
names.meaning: He who is life itself, the vital force that animates all living creatures.

names.name: पर्यवस्थित
names.meaning: He who stands firmly on all sides, pervading and surrounding everything completely.

verses.sanskritDevanagari:
अनन्तरूपोऽनन्तश्रीर्जितमन्युर्भयापहः ।
चतुरश्रो गभीरात्मा विदिशो व्यादिशो दिशः ॥ १००॥
verses.transliteration:
anantarūpo'nantaśrīrjitamanyurbhayāpahaḥ |
caturaśro gabhīrātmā vidiśo vyādiśo diśaḥ || 100 ||

names.name: अनन्तरूप
names.meaning: He who has infinite forms, manifesting in endless shapes throughout creation.

names.name: अनन्तश्री
names.meaning: He whose glory and prosperity are limitless, possessing infinite divine splendour.

names.name: जितमन्यु
names.meaning: He who has conquered anger, having complete mastery over wrath and indignation.

names.name: भयापह
names.meaning: He who removes all fear, dispelling the terror of samsara from the hearts of devotees.

names.name: चतुरश्र
names.meaning: He who deals squarely and justly with all, perfectly balanced in His actions.

names.name: गभीरात्मन्
names.meaning: He whose nature is unfathomably deep, whose Self is of inscrutable profundity.

names.name: विदिश
names.meaning: He who gives special instructions, providing specific guidance for the liberation of each soul.

names.name: व्यादिश
names.meaning: He who commands in diverse ways, issuing orders to various cosmic functionaries.

names.name: दिश
names.meaning: He who is the directions themselves, encompassing all quarters and spatial dimensions.

verses.sanskritDevanagari:
अनादिर्भूर्भुवो लक्ष्मीः सुवीरो रुचिराङ्गदः ।
जननो जनजन्मादिर्भीमो भीमपराक्रमः ॥ १०१॥
verses.transliteration:
anādirbhūrbhuvo lakṣmīḥ suvīro rucirāṅgadaḥ |
janano janajanmādirbhīmo bhīmaparākramaḥ || 101 ||

names.name: अनादि
names.meaning: He who has no beginning, existing before all time and prior to all creation.

names.name: भू
names.meaning: He who is the earth, the very ground of existence and being.

names.name: भुव
names.meaning: He who is the space above the earth, the intermediate realm of existence.

names.name: लक्ष्मी
names.meaning: He who is the abode of Lakshmi, the source and repository of all divine splendour and prosperity.

names.name: सुवीर
names.meaning: He who moves in beautiful ways, or who has excellent heroes as His devotees.

names.name: रुचिराङ्गद
names.meaning: He who wears brilliant armlets, adorned with beautiful and lustrous ornaments.

names.name: जनन
names.meaning: He who causes the birth of all beings, the originator of all living creatures.

names.name: जनजन्मादि
names.meaning: He who is the root cause of the birth of all people, the primal source of all genesis.

names.name: भीम
names.meaning: He who is fearsome and awe-inspiring, terrible to behold in His cosmic wrath.

names.name: भीमपराक्रम
names.meaning: He whose valour is terrifying, whose prowess strikes fear into the hearts of the unrighteous.

verses.sanskritDevanagari:
आधारनिलयोऽधाता पुष्पहासः प्रजागरः ।
ऊर्ध्वगः सत्पथाचारः प्राणदः प्रणवः पणः ॥ १०२॥
verses.transliteration:
ādhāranilayo'dhātā puṣpahāsaḥ prajāgaraḥ |
ūrdhvagaḥ satpathācāraḥ prāṇadaḥ praṇavaḥ paṇaḥ || 102 ||

names.name: आधारनिलय
names.meaning: He who is the support of all foundations, the ultimate base upon which everything rests.

names.name: अधाता
names.meaning: He who is above all support, needing no sustainer as He is self-sustained.

names.name: पुष्पहास
names.meaning: He whose smile is like a blossoming flower, radiating beauty and gentleness.

names.name: प्रजागर
names.meaning: He who is ever wakeful, never sleeping, perpetually conscious and vigilant.

names.name: ऊर्ध्वग
names.meaning: He who moves upward, leading souls toward higher realms of consciousness and liberation.

names.name: सत्पथाचार
names.meaning: He who walks the path of truth, the one who practises and embodies the righteous way.

names.name: प्राणद
names.meaning: He who bestows the life-breath, giving prana to all living creatures.

names.name: प्रणव
names.meaning: He who is Om, the sacred syllable that is the sound-form of the Supreme.

names.name: पण
names.meaning: He who is the transaction of merit, the supreme wager in the game of life and liberation.

verses.sanskritDevanagari:
प्रमाणं प्राणनिलयः प्राणभृत्प्राणजीवनः ।
तत्त्वं तत्त्वविदेकात्मा जन्ममृत्युजरातिगः ॥ १०३॥
verses.transliteration:
pramāṇaṃ prāṇanilayaḥ prāṇabhṛtprāṇajīvanaḥ |
tattvaṃ tattvavidekātmā janmamṛtyujarātigaḥ || 103 ||

names.name: प्रमाण
names.meaning: He who is the ultimate standard of knowledge, the supreme authority and means of valid cognition.

names.name: प्राणनिलय
names.meaning: He who is the abode of all life-breaths, the resting place where prana finds its source.

names.name: प्राणभृत्
names.meaning: He who sustains the life-breath of all beings, nourishing and maintaining prana.

names.name: प्राणजीवन
names.meaning: He who is the life of life itself, the vital force that animates even prana.

names.name: तत्त्व
names.meaning: He who is the essential truth, the fundamental reality designated as 'That' (tat).

names.name: तत्त्वविद्
names.meaning: He who knows the truth of all realities, the knower of every essential principle.

names.name: एकात्मन्
names.meaning: He who is the one Self in all beings, the singular consciousness pervading everything.

names.name: जन्ममृत्युजरातिग
names.meaning: He who transcends birth, death, and old age, being beyond all mortal limitations.

verses.sanskritDevanagari:
भूर्भुवःस्वस्तरुस्तारः सविता प्रपितामहः ।
यज्ञो यज्ञपतिर्यज्वा यज्ञाङ्गो यज्ञवाहनः ॥ १०४॥
verses.transliteration:
bhūrbhuvaḥsvastarustarāḥ savitā prapitāmahaḥ |
yajño yajñapatiryajvā yajñāṅgo yajñavāhanaḥ || 104 ||

names.name: भूर्भुवःस्वस्तरु
names.meaning: He who is the tree of bhuh, bhuvah, and svah — the cosmic tree spanning all three worlds.

names.name: तार
names.meaning: He who enables the crossing over of samsara, the saviour who delivers beings to liberation.

names.name: सविता
names.meaning: He who is the begetter of all, the divine progenitor who generates the entire universe.

names.name: प्रपितामह
names.meaning: He who is the great-grandfather, the progenitor even of Brahma the creator.

names.name: यज्ञ
names.meaning: He who is the sacrifice itself, the very form and essence of all sacred rituals.

names.name: यज्ञपति
names.meaning: He who is the lord of all sacrifices, the master to whom every offering is ultimately directed.

names.name: यज्वन्
names.meaning: He who is the performer of sacrifice, the ideal sacrificer who embodies the spirit of yajna.

names.name: यज्ञाङ्ग
names.meaning: He whose limbs are the parts of the sacrifice, whose body constitutes the components of yajna.

names.name: यज्ञवाहन
names.meaning: He who carries the sacrifice to fruition, the vehicle through which yajna reaches its goal.

verses.sanskritDevanagari:
यज्ञभृद् यज्ञकृद् यज्ञी यज्ञभुग्यज्ञसाधनः ।
यज्ञान्तकृद् यज्ञगुह्यमन्नमन्नाद एव च ॥ १०५॥
verses.transliteration:
yajñabhṛd yajñakṛd yajñī yajñabhugyajñasādhanaḥ |
yajñāntakṛd yajñaguhyamannamannāda eva ca || 105 ||

names.name: यज्ञभृत्
names.meaning: He who sustains the sacrifice, supporting and maintaining the continuity of all yajnas.

names.name: यज्ञकृत्
names.meaning: He who performs the sacrifice, the one who initiates and carries out the yajna.

names.name: यज्ञिन्
names.meaning: He who is the enjoyer of yajna, the one for whose sake all sacrifices are performed.

names.name: यज्ञभुक्
names.meaning: He who consumes the sacrifice, receiving and partaking of all that is offered in yajna.

names.name: यज्ञसाधन
names.meaning: He who is the instrument of sacrifice, the means by which yajna is accomplished.

names.name: यज्ञान्तकृत्
names.meaning: He who brings the sacrifice to completion, concluding the yajna and bestowing its fruits.

names.name: यज्ञगुह्य
names.meaning: He who is the secret of the sacrifice, the hidden mystery at the heart of every yajna.

names.name: अन्न
names.meaning: He who is food itself, the nourishment that sustains all living beings.

names.name: अन्नाद
names.meaning: He who is the eater of food, consuming all creation at the time of dissolution.

verses.sanskritDevanagari:
आत्मयोनिः स्वयञ्जातो वैखानः सामगायनः ।
देवकीनन्दनः स्रष्टा क्षितीशः पापनाशनः ॥ १०६॥
verses.transliteration:
ātmayoniḥ svayañjāto vaikhānaḥ sāmagāyanaḥ |
devakīnandanaḥ sraṣṭā kṣitīśaḥ pāpanāśanaḥ || 106 ||

names.name: आत्मयोनि
names.meaning: He who is self-born, whose origin is His own Self, having no external cause.

names.name: स्वयञ्जात
names.meaning: He who manifests by His own will, born of His own volition without dependence on another.

names.name: वैखान
names.meaning: He who is the originator of the Vaikhanasa tradition, the Lord who dug through the earth as Varaha.

names.name: सामगायन
names.meaning: He who sings the Sama Veda, delighting in the melodious chanting of the sacred hymns.

names.name: देवकीनन्दन
names.meaning: He who is the beloved son of Devaki, the joy and delight of His divine mother.

names.name: स्रष्टा
names.meaning: He who is the creator of the entire universe, bringing forth all worlds and beings.

names.name: क्षितीश
names.meaning: He who is the lord of the earth, the sovereign ruler of the terrestrial realm.

names.name: पापनाशन
names.meaning: He who destroys all sins, annihilating the accumulated papa of those who worship Him.

verses.sanskritDevanagari:
शङ्खभृन्नन्दकी चक्री शार्ङ्गधन्वा गदाधरः ।
रथाङ्गपाणिरक्षोभ्यः सर्वप्रहरणायुधः ॥ १०७॥
verses.transliteration:
śaṅkhabhṛnnandakī cakrī śārṅgadhanvā gadādharaḥ |
rathāṅgapāṇirakṣobhyaḥ sarvapraharaṇāyudhaḥ || 107 ||

names.name: शङ्खभृत्
names.meaning: He who bears the divine conch Panchajanya, the wielder of the sacred shell.

names.name: नन्दकिन्
names.meaning: He who wields the sword named Nandaka, the bearer of the divine blade of joy.

names.name: चक्रिन्
names.meaning: He who bears the Sudarshana discus, wielding the supreme wheel of cosmic order.

names.name: शार्ङ्गधन्वन्
names.meaning: He who holds the bow called Sharnga, the wielder of the divine bow.

names.name: गदाधर
names.meaning: He who holds the mace called Kaumodaki, the bearer of the divine club.

names.name: सर्वप्रहरणायुध
names.meaning: He who wields all weapons of divine assault, the Lord armed with every instrument of cosmic protection.
